AI.method: 采用双流架构，分别处理CLAHE增强的RGB帧和体素化的事件张量；通过基于最小方差线性估计理论的自适应跨模态融合（ACMF）模块学习注意力图，理论上渐近恢复Gauss-Markov最优融合权重；对体素化阶段建立了事件守恒和时间分辨率边界。
AI.result: 在LLE-VOS基准上，Recall达到65.54%，Precision达到53.85%，F1-Score达到59.12%，在严重光照退化条件下Recall显著优于单模态检测器。
AI.conclusion: AdaFuse-Det通过理论驱动的跨模态融合策略有效解决了极端低光目标检测难题，其性能提升与理论预测的照明自适应行为一致，验证了该方法在低光照视觉应用中的实用价值。

title: Mimir: Large-scale Multilingual Concept Modeling
summary: Current language modeling approaches are built around tokens. Text corpora are split into tokens, and models are trained by performing computations on these tokens, such as predicting the next token given the preceding ones as context. This paradigm has become the standard in modern language modeling, especially given the outstanding performance obtained by token-based architectures. However, recent works have not only begun to question how language models process and understand meaning from tokens, but also to question whether using higher levels of granularity could advance the research field. This led to the idea of Concept Modeling, that is, to directly train models for next-concept prediction rather than next-token prediction. The goal is to change the input from tokens to concepts, forcing the underlying language model to shift its granularity from fine-grained tokens to broad concepts. In this work, we introduce Mimir, a 1.6B Large Concept Model trained for multilingual concept understanding and generation. We leverage a large-scale multilingual pre-training corpus (38,883,987,240 sentences) spanning 46 languages and a large-scale multi-turn and multilingual instruction-tuning dataset (66,816,428 sentences) covering a total of 35 languages. We extensively evaluate model performance against a language model with a comparable number of parameters.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Mimir，一个16亿参数的大型概念模型，从传统的基于token的语言建模转向基于概念（concept）的建模，通过大规模多语言预训练和指令微调，实现多语言概念理解和生成。
AI.motivation: 传统语言模型基于token粒度进行训练，但token可能无法有效捕获语义信息。研究者质疑token-level方法对意义理解的局限性，探索使用更高粒度（概念）进行建模的可能性。
AI.method: 提出Mimir模型，将输入从token转换为concept，采用next-concept prediction替代next-token prediction；使用包含46种语言的388亿句子进行多语言预训练，以及35种语言的6682万句子进行多轮指令微调。
AI.result: 在同等参数量级下，将Mimir与传统的语言模型进行多维度评估对比。
AI.conclusion: 概念级建模（Concept Modeling）是语言模型发展的一个潜在方向，通过改变输入粒度从token到concept，可能推动研究领域的进步。

title: SRUG: Shadow-Guided Relightable Urban Scene with Generation Model
summary: Creating relightable urban scenes from images or videos is widely useful but highly ill-posed. Urban environments are typically unbounded and extend beyond the visible regions. As a result, many portions of the scene remain unobserved, yet these invisible regions can cast shadows onto visible areas. Reasonably modeling shadows cast by such invisible regions is challenging and poses a significant obstacle to creating relightable urban scenes. At the same time, sparse input views and complex illumination conditions further complicate relighting, as they introduce severe ambiguities in material decomposition. In this paper, we propose Shadow-guided Relightable Urban Scene with Generation model (SRUG), a novel framework designed to address relighting challenges in urban scenes. SRUG leverages shadows to guide a 3D completion model for recovering the geometry of invisible regions, promoting the synthesis of physically reasonable shadows. In addition, SRUG employs an iterative material decomposition scheme that applies the large material model (LMM) to provide material supervision and iteratively decompose the scene's material properties, enabling robust material decomposition. Building upon these components, we introduce a physically-based lighting model that captures the complex illumination of urban scenes and supports reliable relighting. Extensive quantitative evaluations and visual comparisons demonstrate that our method outperforms existing approaches in both novel view synthesis and relighting tasks.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SRUG框架，利用阴影引导3D补全模型恢复不可见区域的几何结构，结合迭代材质分解方案和基于物理的光照模型，实现了城市场景的重光照，在视图合成和重光照任务上优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 城市场景通常无边界且超出可见区域，不可见部分仍会向可见区域投射阴影，而稀疏输入视图和复杂光照条件进一步加剧了材质分解的歧义性，给重光照带来巨大挑战。
AI.method: 1) 利用阴影引导3D补全模型恢复不可见区域几何；2) 提出迭代材质分解方案，利用大材质模型(LMM)提供材质监督；3) 引入基于物理的光照模型以捕捉复杂光照。
AI.result: 在视图合成和重光照任务上，定量评估和视觉比较均优于现有方法。
AI.conclusion: SRUG框架有效解决了城市场景重光照中的阴影建模和材质分解难题，取得了更优的性能。

title: READER: Reasoning-Enhanced AI-Generated Text Detection
summary: Recent advances in large language models (LLMs) have made it increasingly difficult to distinguish human-written text from AI-generated content. Many existing detectors train supervised neural classifiers that achieve strong in-distribution performance but are often opaque and can degrade substantially under distribution shift. We present READER, a reasoning-enhanced AI text detector that outputs both a human/AI label and a structured rationale describing the evidence for its decision. A key component of our approach is READ, a curated supervision set of rationales and verdicts. We fine-tune an LLM on READ to build READER, which reasons before detecting at inference time. Despite having only 1.5B parameters, READER consistently outperforms existing detectors as well as prompted, high-capacity LLM baselines (GPT-5.2, Gemini-3-Pro, and DeepSeek-V3.2), which are 100 to 1000 times larger in scale.

AI.tldr: READER是一个轻量级（1.5B参数）的AI文本检测器，通过引入结构化推理机制，在分布外场景下显著优于比其大100-1000倍的模型。
AI.motivation: 现有AI文本检测器在分布偏移下性能严重下降，且缺乏可解释性，难以提供判断依据。
AI.method: 构建READ监督数据集（包含推理过程和判定结果），微调1.5B参数的LLM，使其在检测前先进行结构化推理，输出标签和推理依据。
AI.result: 在多种检测任务上，READER持续超越现有检测器及GPT-5.2、Gemini-3-Pro、DeepSeek-V3.2等大100-1000倍的模型。
AI.conclusion: 引入推理机制可以有效提升AI文本检测的鲁棒性和可解释性，小型模型也能通过结构化推理超越大型模型。

title: Beyond Inference-Only Deployment: Comparing Weight-Based Consolidation Against Cascading Compaction
summary: Major LLM platforms deploy models in an inference-only configuration: the model serves requests but never updates per-user weights. Users must repeatedly re-teach preferences, corrections, and project context, and context-based workarounds consume context-window space and degrade under cascading compaction. We evaluate an alternative: nightly consolidation of interaction knowledge into model weights via reflection, synthesis, and Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) fine-tuning on a single consumer GPU. Across ten realistic software development conversations (n = 10, 1,146 test questions across three memory types), three cycles of cascading compaction retain 36.8 +/- 3.0% of knowledge (between an 11.8% no-context floor and a 90.1% full-context ceiling), while consolidation retains 80.4 +/- 1.3% -- a 43.6 pp gain (paired t(9) = 14.8, p < 0.001) that more than doubles what compaction preserves, with the largest gains on procedural corrections (36.3% -> 74.6%) and episodic project facts (31.5% -> 78.2%). As a methodological aside, mean per-token validation cross-entropy is negatively correlated with LLM-judged accuracy (r = -0.51) while median per-token validation cross-entropy tracks accuracy almost exactly (r = +0.99): under evaluators that tolerate surface-form variation, the mean is misleading and a heavy-tail-robust statistic is the faithful signal. Persistent personalization requires moving beyond inference-only deployment toward architectures that consolidate knowledge into weights.

AI.tldr: 本文提出通过反射、合成和LoRA微调，在单张消费级GPU上将交互知识夜间整合到模型权重中，相比级联压缩（36.8%）显著提升知识保留率至80.4%，实现了超越推理-only架构的持久个性化。
AI.motivation: 当前主流LLM平台采用推理-only部署，无法更新用户专属权重，导致用户必须反复重述偏好、修正和项目上下文；基于上下文的补救方案会消耗上下文窗口空间且性能退化。
AI.method: 夜间将交互知识通过反射（reflection）、合成（synthesis）和低秩适配（LoRA）微调整合到模型权重中，在单张消费级GPU上运行。
AI.result: 在10段真实软件开发对话（n=10, 1,146个测试问题）中，三个周期的级联压缩保留36.8±3.0%的知识，而整合方法保留80.4±1.3%，提升43.6个百分点（paired t(9)=14.8, p<0.001）。程序性修正从36.3%提升至74.6%，情景性项目事实从31.5%提升至78.2%。此外发现平均per-token验证交叉熵与LLM判定的准确性呈负相关（r=-0.51），而中位数则几乎完全正相关（r=+0.99）。
AI.conclusion: 持久个性化需要超越推理-only部署，转向能将知识整合到权重的架构。

title: Do Image-Text Metrics Respect Semantic Invariances?
summary: Reference-free image-to-text evaluators are now standard for scoring image-caption alignment, yet it is unclear whether they respect semantic invariances. We present an invariance probe on five popular evaluators (CLIPScore, PAC-S, UMIC, FLEUR, and a deterministic LLM judge) under semantics-preserving perturbations along three axes -- spatial (flips, context-preserving repositioning, light rotations), object (scale, category), and socio-linguistic framing (cultural/economic adjectives with neutral and length-matched controls). Across curated slices of three detection datasets and three caption evaluation suites, we find consistent non-semantic sensitivities, where benign spatial edits and simple phrasing changes shift scores by $\approx$6--9\% on average, and for systems separated by just 0.7\%, these shifts can cause ranking flips in up to $\sim$37\% of cases, particularly under spatial changes. A small human study also supports this finding and confirms that annotators generally judge perturbed pairs as equally correct, so these shifts reflect metric behavior rather than semantic change. We further propose invariance-calibrated scoring, a post-hoc adjustment that roughly halves median absolute sensitivity while retaining correlation with learned caption evaluators.

AI.tldr: 现有图像-文本评估器在语义不变性方面存在缺陷，空间、对象和社会语言学层面的微小扰动会导致评分显著变化（平均6-9%），甚至引发排名翻转（最高37%）。作者提出了校准方法，可将敏感度降低约一半。
AI.motivation: 尽管无参考图像-文本评估器已被广泛使用，但它们是否真正尊重语义不变性（即在语义不变的情况下给出稳定评分）尚不清楚。作者旨在系统性地探测这些评估器对非语义扰动的敏感性。
AI.method: 在三种语义保持扰动（空间、对象、社会语言学框架）下，对五个流行评估器（CLIPScore, PAC-S, UMIC, FLEUR, 确定性LLM法官）进行不变性探测，并在三个检测数据集和三个字幕评估套件上测试。同时进行了小规模人工验证实验，并提出后验的"不变性校准评分"方法。
AI.result: 所有评估器对非语义扰动均表现出一致的敏感性：空间编辑和措辞变化平均引起6-9%的评分波动；在仅相差0.7%的系统间，扰动可导致高达37%的案例发生排名翻转。人工研究确认这些评分变化反映的是评估器行为缺陷而非语义变化。提出的校准方法可将中位绝对敏感度降低约一半。
AI.conclusion: 当前图像-文本评估器在语义不变性上存在显著缺陷，需要引入不变性校准来提升评估的可靠性。

title: Knowing but Not Showing: LLMs Recognize Ambiguity but Rarely Ask Clarifying Questions
summary: User queries are often underspecified and may admit multiple valid interpretations. Rather than silently making assumptions about the user's intent, a helpful assistant should surface such ambiguity by asking a clarifying question. Doing so requires two abilities: recognizing that a query is ambiguous, and acting on that recognition by seeking clarification instead of answering directly. To study these abilities, we evaluate models on ambiguous, unambiguous, and disambiguated questions in three settings: standard question answering, explicit ambiguity judgment, and behavioral analysis, where a judge model classifies responses as direct answers, refusals, or clarifying questions. We find a clear gap between recognition and behavior: models often identify ambiguity when explicitly asked to judge it, yet in the QA setting they overwhelmingly default to direct answers. Retrieved context further widens this gap by improving answerability while making models even less likely to ask clarifying questions.

AI.tldr: 模型能识别模糊问题，但在问答场景中默认直接回答而非主动澄清，检索上下文进一步加剧了这一问题。
AI.motivation: 用户查询常常表述模糊且存在多种合理解释，理想的助手应主动提出澄清性问题而非默默假设用户意图，但现有模型在这方面表现不足。
AI.method: 在模糊、明确和消歧后的问题上，从三个维度评估模型：标准问答、显式歧义判断、以及行为分析（用裁判模型将回答分类为直接答案、拒绝或澄清性问题）。
AI.result: 模型在显式判断歧义时表现良好，但在问答场景中几乎总是直接回答；检索上下文提高了答案的可得性，但进一步降低了模型提出澄清性问题的倾向。
AI.conclusion: 模型存在歧义识别与行为之间的显著差距，检索上下文加剧了这一差距。

title: Measuring Reasoning Quality in LLMs: A Multi-Dimensional Behavioral Framework
summary: LLMs have achieved remarkable success in complex reasoning tasks, yet current evaluation approaches predominantly rely on final-answer correctness, offering limited insight into the underlying reasoning processes that produce those answers. To address this gap, this study proposes a unified multi-dimensional framework for measuring reasoning quality in LLMs from a behavioral perspective, operationalizing six theoretically grounded dimensions: Correctness (CQ), Consistency (CS), Robustness (RS), Logical Coherence (LS), Efficiency (ES), and Stability (SS). Extensive experiments on seven LLMs across 975 items from four benchmarks demonstrate that the framework reveals behaviors invisible to accuracy-only metrics. Notably, logical coherence is orthogonal to correctness (r = -0.172, ns), confirming that correct answers can arise from incoherent reasoning, while Claude-Haiku-4.5 achieves the highest multi-dimensional score (Q_bal = 0.778). Furthermore, the framework exposes critical ranking inversions: DeepSeek-V3 ranks second under accuracy-priority but fifth under legal/compliance weighting, a reversal that single-metric evaluation cannot detect. Discriminant validity confirms 11/15 dimension pairs are independent (|r| < 0.50), providing psychometric support for treating each dimension as a distinct signal. The dimensional profiles produced by the framework directly support three classes of deployment decision: identifying models whose reasoning traces would fail accountability audits despite correct final answers (LS--CQ orthogonality); preventing ranking errors caused by accuracy-only benchmarking; and ensuring that no single metric silently substitutes for the six independent signals the framework captures.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个多维度推理质量评估框架，涵盖正确性、一致性、鲁棒性、逻辑连贯性、效率、稳定性六个维度，证明仅依赖正确答案准确率无法全面反映LLM的推理质量，且不同维度之间存在独立性，能揭示排名反转等关键现象。
AI.motivation: 当前LLM评估过度依赖最终答案正确性，缺乏对推理过程质量的深入洞察，需要更全面的评估框架来捕捉推理行为的多样性。
AI.method: 从行为视角构建六维度推理质量评估框架（CQ、CS、RS、LS、ES、SS），在7个LLM、975个样本、4个基准上进行实验，并进行判别效度分析检验维度独立性。
AI.result: 逻辑连贯性与正确性正交（r=-0.172, ns）；Claude-Haiku-4.5综合得分最高（Q_bal=0.778）；DeepSeek-V3在准确性优先下排名第二，但在法律/合规权重下降至第五；11/15维度对独立（|r|<0.50）。
AI.conclusion: 该框架支持三类部署决策：识别答案正确但推理过程不达标的模型、防止单指标排名错误、确保多维度信号不被单一指标替代。

title: Physics-Guided Self-Supervised Statistical Residual Learning for Sonar Despeckling with Improved Generalization
summary: This letter introduces a physics-informed self-supervised framework for sonar image despeckling that reformulates despeckling as residual consistency in the homomorphic log domain. By constraining the log-ratio residual to obey multiplicative speckle statistics, the proposed method eliminates the need for clean supervision while preventing degenerate identity solutions. A variance-targeted statistical loss combined with edge-aware structural regularization and median-guided curriculum stabilization enables effective speckle suppression with preserved structural fidelity. This formulation along with a lightweight neural network achieves state-of-the-art performance across multiple real sonar datasets and demonstrates excellent cross-dataset robustness, while remaining suitable for real-time deployment.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种基于物理信息自监督学习的声纳图像去斑框架，通过对数域残差一致性约束实现无需干净标签的去噪，在保持结构保真度的同时实现实时部署。
AI.motivation: 声纳图像去斑需要干净标签，而实际中难以获取；现有方法容易产生退化解，且难以在性能和实时性间取得平衡。
AI.method: 采用同态对数域的残差一致性约束，利用方差目标统计损失、边缘感知结构正则化和中值引导课程学习，结合轻量级神经网络实现自监督去斑。
AI.result: 在多个真实声纳数据集上达到最先进性能，表现出优秀的跨数据集鲁棒性，并适用于实时部署。
AI.conclusion: 该物理信息自监督框架有效解决了声纳去斑中缺乏干净标签的问题，兼顾了去斑效果与计算效率。

title: Eureka: Intelligent Feature Engineering for Enterprise AI Cloud Resource Demand Prediction
comment: 13 pages, accepted at DASFAA 2026 (International Conference on Database Systems for Advanced Applications)
summary: Effective features are crucial for predictive model performance, but creating them often requires domain expertise, limiting scalability across applications. We define feature engineering as an agentic code generation problem: features are not static data transformations, but executable programs that can be generated, evaluated, and iteratively improved. We present Eureka, an LLM-driven framework with three stages. (1) An Expert Agent, fine-tuned via SFT on domain knowledge, produces structured feature design plans in JSON format. (2) An LLM Feature Factory translates each plan into executable Python code through chain-of-thought reasoning, turning feature hypotheses into runnable programs. (3) A Self-Evolving Alignment Engine uses Reinforcement Learning (GRPO) with dual-channel reward (metric-based utility + semantic alignment) to enhance code quality. By expressing features as programs, the learned generation patterns can transfer across domains. Evaluated on 7 public benchmarks in healthcare, finance, and social domains, Eureka consistently outperforms both traditional AutoFE and LLM-based baselines. We further demonstrate Eureka's effectiveness on cloud GPU resource demand prediction at Alibaba Cloud, where Eureka improves demand fulfillment rate by 16% and lowers computing resource migration rates by 33%.

AI.tldr: Eureka是一个LLM驱动的特征工程框架，将特征工程定义为智能体代码生成问题，通过专家代理、特征工厂和自进化对齐引擎三阶段流程，在医疗、金融和社交领域的7个基准测试以及阿里云GPU资源预测任务中取得显著效果。
AI.motivation: 传统特征工程依赖领域专家知识，难以规模化应用。现有方法缺乏将特征表达为可执行程序的能力，限制了特征生成模式在不同领域间的迁移。
AI.method: 三阶段框架：(1) Expert Agent通过SFT微调生成结构化特征设计方案；(2) LLM Feature Factory通过思维链推理将方案转为可执行Python代码；(3) Self-Evolving Alignment Engine使用GRPO强化学习，结合指标效用和语义对齐的双通道奖励来提升代码质量。
AI.result: 在7个公开基准测试（医疗、金融、社交领域）上优于传统AutoFE和基于LLM的基线方法；在阿里云GPU资源需求预测中，需求满足率提升16%，计算资源迁移率降低33%。
AI.conclusion: 将特征工程表达为可执行程序，使得学习到的生成模式能够跨领域迁移，是一种有效且可扩展的特征工程新范式。

title: When Mean CE Fails: Median CE Can Better Track Language Model Quality
summary:
Mean cross-entropy is the standard validation metric for language models, but it can fail to track model quality during training. We examine this in two common scenarios. First, in Qwen2.5-1.5B SFT on synthetic fact-learning, we find that mean CE rises substantially after the initial learning phase while held-out fact-recall accuracy remains near its peak. Second, we find that in top-K distillation on TinyStories, decreasing K improves median CE while worsening mean CE; the Top-5 student attains the highest LLM-judge score and crosses below its teacher on median CE, despite having the worst mean CE. In both cases, median CE correlates much more closely with task performance than does mean CE.
  Analyzing how bulk and tail percentile CE move during training reveals that training reshapes the empirical per-token CE distribution. In top-K distillation, smaller K yields a distribution with more mass at both extremes, decreasing the median and increasing the mean. In Qwen SFT, the bulk saturates quickly while the tail extends in the latter half of training. In both, the task-evaluation metric appears more sensitive to the bulk than to the tail.
  Practically, we recommend reporting a small set of percentile CE summaries alongside the mean, and using concordance among them as a tool to keep track of distribution reshaping, as well as a low-cost diagnostic for when mean and median CE disagree on model selection.

AI.tldr: 平均交叉熵（Mean CE）作为语言模型的标准验证指标，在训练过程中可能无法准确反映模型质量。研究发现，在两种常见场景（Qwen2.5-1.5B SFT合成事实学习和TinyStories top-K蒸馏）中，中位数CE比平均CE更能与任务性能指标（如事实回忆准确率和LLM评分）保持一致。训练过程重塑了每个token的CE分布，导致均值和分位数指标产生分歧。建议在报告平均CE的同时补充一组百分位数CE摘要，并将其一致性作为模型选择的低成本诊断工具。
AI.motivation: 标准语言模型验证指标——平均交叉熵（Mean CE）在训练中可能无法准确反映模型质量，导致模型选择时出现偏差。本文旨在系统分析该问题，探究其成因并提出改进建议。
AI.method: 通过两个实验场景进行实证分析：（1）Qwen2.5-1.5B在合成事实学习上的SFT训练；（2）TinyStories上的top-K蒸馏实验。通过分析逐token CE分布的百分位数变化（bulk和tail的动态），揭示平均CE失效的机制。
AI.result: （1）在Qwen SFT中，平均CE在初始学习阶段后大幅上升，而事实回忆准确率保持峰值；（2）在TinyStories蒸馏中，减小K改善中位数CE但恶化平均CE，Top-5学生模型获得最高LLM评分，其平均CE最差但中位数CE优于教师模型。在这两种情况下，中位数CE与任务性能的相关性远高于平均CE。
AI.conclusion: 平均CE在训练过程中可能因CE分布重塑（bulk饱和而tail延伸）而成为不可靠指标。建议实践中补充报告百分位数CE摘要，并利用各分位数指标间的一致性作为低成本诊断工具，特别在平均CE与中位数CE出现分歧时辅助模型选择。

title: Tool-Call Dependency Structure is Linearly Decodable in LLM Agent Residual Streams
summary: Tool-using LLM agents produce trajectories whose calls form a directed dependency graph: earlier tool outputs supply arguments to later calls. Whether this execution structure is represented inside the model is unknown; prior structural probes have targeted static code or chain-of-thought text, not an agent's run-time call graph. A low-capacity edge probe on the residual stream of Qwen3-32B decodes the tool-call dependency graph well above both a Hewitt--Liang random-label control and a positional baseline. A counterfactual contrast between value corruption and structural perturbation indicates the signal tracks abstract topology rather than identifier values, and replicates under an independent, non-substring oracle. The non-positional component replicates on three further interactive multi-hop benchmarks and attenuates as call order alone becomes a sufficient proxy for dependency, vanishing in single-shot planning. Per-layer activation patching shifts the probe at a later, non-patched boundary, evidence that the representation propagates rather than passively reads out, though the realised tool call does not move. To our knowledge this is the first structural probe of an LLM agent's runtime tool-call dependency graph. Our claims concern representation, not behavioural control, and span two model families and one primary domain.

AI.tldr: 首次对LLM智能体运行时工具调用依赖图进行结构探针分析，发现残差流中编码了抽象的调用拓扑结构，且该表示会传播而非被动读取。
AI.motivation: 工具调用轨迹形成有向依赖图，但模型内部是否表征这种执行结构尚不清楚；现有结构探针仅针对静态代码或思维链文本，未涉及智能体的运行时调用图。
AI.method: 在Qwen3-32B残差流上使用低容量边探针解码工具调用依赖图，通过数值腐败与结构扰动对比区分抽象拓扑与标识符值，并在多个多跳基准上验证。使用逐层激活修补探测表示的传播性。
AI.result: 探针显著优于随机标签控制和位置基线；非位置成分在多个基准上复现，当调用顺序足以作为依赖代理时信号减弱，在单步规划中消失；激活修补表明表示会跨层传播。
AI.conclusion: LLM智能体运行时工具调用依赖图的拓扑结构在模型内部有显式表征，且该表征是动态传播的；这是首个针对智能体运行时调用图的结构探针工作。

title: From Full Boards to Tiny Defects: Scale-Aware Tile Inference with Topology-Aware Merging for High-Resolution PCB Defect Detection
summary: High-resolution printed circuit board (PCB) inspection suffers from resolution collapse when full-board images are resized to standard detector inputs: micro-scale defects shrink to a few pixels and are missed. Tile-based inference preserves local detail but introduces boundary artefacts at tile edges, causing split detections and false negatives. We present a systematic comparison of five inference strategies evaluated on two high-resolution PCB defect datasets, PCB-Defect (230 images, 1704 annotations) and HRIPCB (693 images, 2 953 annotations), spanning six defect classes. We show that training-inference scale consistency is critical: a detector trained on full images collapses to mAP@50 = 0.01 under tile inference, while the same architecture trained on 640*640 tile crops achieves 0.72 and 0.94 on the two datasets respectively. We further exploited Topology-Aware Tile Merging (TA-TM), a training-free post-processing method that builds a tile-adjacency graph and adjusts boundary-sensitive detection scores using neighbour-tile agreement before global NMS. Across both datasets, adding 128 px tile overlap raises boundary-zone recall from ~26-63% to ~70-100%, TA-TM achieves the best mAP@50 on both benchmarks, and tile inference recovers 46-100% of small defects missed entirely by full-image methods. Results are consistent across datasets, confirming the generalizability of the proposed strategy. TA-TM requires no retraining and is architecture-agnostic, making it directly applicable to existing PCB inspection pipelines.

AI.tldr: 本文针对高分辨率PCB缺陷检测中因图像缩放导致微小缺陷丢失、以及基于图块推理产生边界伪影的问题，系统比较了五种推理策略，并提出一种无需训练、与架构无关的拓扑感知图块合并方法（TA-TM），在两个数据集上显著提升了检测性能，尤其是对微小缺陷的召回率。
AI.motivation: 高分辨率PCB全板图像缩放至标准检测器输入尺寸时，微尺度缺陷缩小至几个像素而被遗漏；而基于图块的推理虽能保留局部细节，但在图块边缘引入边界伪影，导致缺陷被分割检测或产生假阴性。
AI.method: 系统比较了五种推理策略；验证了训练-推理尺度一致性的重要性；提出Topology-Aware Tile Merging (TA-TM)方法，构建图块邻接图，利用邻居图块一致性调整边界敏感检测得分，再执行全局NMS。
AI.result: 训练-推理尺度不一致时mAP@50=0.01，一致时分别达0.72和0.94；添加128像素重叠将边界区域召回率从~26-63%提升至~70-100%；TA-TM在两个数据集上均取得最佳mAP@50；图块推理恢复46-100%被全图方法遗漏的微小缺陷。
AI.conclusion: TA-TM无需重新训练且架构无关，可直接应用于现有PCB检测流程，结果在两个数据集上一致，验证了策略的泛化性。

title: P1SCO: Social Dimensions from a Perspectivist Lens
summary: We introduce P1SCO, a dataset of social media comments collected from three distinct platforms, annotated according to ten social dimensions to capture the diversity of social interactions and perceptions. The dataset is carefully disaggregated to allow analysis at the level of individual comments, annotators, and platforms. In addition to the social dimension labels, we include rich metadata on the annotators, including demographics, Big Five personality profiles, and political affiliation. This combination of comment-level annotations and annotator-level features enables nuanced analyses of how social perception varies across platforms, individual differences, and demographic factors. By preserving the diversity of annotator perspectives, our dataset supports studies of inter- and intra-annotator agreement, the influence of personality and political orientation on social interpretation, and the cross-platform dynamics of social discourse.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了P1SCO数据集，包含来自三个不同社交媒体平台的评论，按十个社会维度进行标注，并收集了标注者的人口统计学、大五人格和政治倾向等元数据，支持多层面的社会感知分析。
AI.motivation: 现有社会标注数据集缺乏跨平台、多维度及标注者个体差异的细粒度分析能力，难以研究社会感知如何因平台、人格和政治倾向等因素而变化。
AI.method: 从三个不同社交媒体平台收集评论，按照十个社会维度进行标注，并采集标注者的人口统计学信息、大五人格画像和政治倾向等丰富元数据，实现评论级、标注者级和平台级的多层次解构分析。
AI.result: 构建了P1SCO数据集，支持评论、标注者和平台三个层面的分析，保留了标注者视角的多样性，可用于研究标注者间/标注者内一致性、人格和政治倾向对社会解读的影响，以及跨平台社会话语动态。
AI.conclusion: P1SCO数据集通过保留多维度社会互动和感知的多样性，为研究社会感知的跨平台差异、个体差异和人口统计因素影响提供了丰富的资源。

title: MATO: Multi-objective Personalized Alignment with Test-time Optimization for Large Language Models
summary: Aligning large language models (LLMs) with diverse and multifaceted user preferences is a fundamental challenge in personalized AI systems. Existing multi-objective alignment methods either rely on costly training or require pre-trained reward models for each preference, making it difficult for them to adapt to evolving preferences. Prompt-based personalization offers a training-free alternative, but prompting alone often provides limited steerability, as LLMs may overemphasize or overlook certain preferences and fail to give users reliable control over the relative importance of different objectives when conflicts arise, leading to suboptimal alignment. In this paper, we introduce MATO, a training-free framework for Multi-objective personalized Alignment with Test-time Optimization. MATO formulates personalization as a test-time optimization problem that steers the relative importance of multiple objectives through controllable weights during decoding, without modifying model parameters or requiring external reward models. Specifically, a reward discovery module recovers preference rewards directly from the backbone LLM for diverse objectives specified in natural language, while a weight optimization module dynamically adjusts objective weights based on the user's initial preferences and the partially generated response to balance competing objectives during generation. The resulting rewards and weights jointly guide an online optimization procedure over the token distribution, enabling better alignment with the target objectives. Extensive experiments across multiple datasets and backbone LLMs show that MATO consistently outperforms strong baselines, achieving Pareto-improving multi-objective alignment and stronger steerability. These results highlight test-time optimization as a promising direction for scalable, controllable, and model-agnostic personalized alignment.

AI.tldr: 本文提出MATO，一种无需训练的多目标个性化对齐框架，通过在解码阶段进行测试时优化，动态调整多个偏好的权重，实现更好的可控性和对齐效果。
AI.motivation: 现有方法要么需要昂贵训练，要么依赖预训练奖励模型，难以适应动态变化的用户偏好；基于提示的方法可操控性有限，无法可靠控制不同目标间的相对重要性。
AI.method: MATO包含两个核心模块：(1) 奖励发现模块，直接从主干LLM中恢复各偏好的奖励；(2) 权重优化模块，基于用户初始偏好和部分生成的响应动态调整目标权重。两者联合指导解码阶段的在线优化过程。
AI.result: 在多个数据集和多种骨干LLM上的实验表明，MATO持续优于强基线方法，实现了帕累托改进的多目标对齐和更强的可操控性。
AI.conclusion: 测试时优化是实现可扩展、可控且模型无关的个性化对齐的有前景方向。

title: Motion-Compensated Weight Compression
summary: Neural network weights are increasingly a bottleneck for deployment, yet most compression pipelines treat layers independently and overlook cross-layer redundancy induced by function-preserving symmetries. We propose Motion-Compensated Weight Compression (MCWC), a weight-only codec that aligns permutation-symmetric blocks (e.g., hidden units and attention heads) to maximize cross-layer correspondence, turning depth into a predictable sequence. In the aligned coordinate system, MCWC uses a lightweight layer-sequential predictor with periodic keyframes and encodes only quantized prediction residuals using a learned entropy model trained under a rate distortion objective. A simple decoder reconstructs deployable weights by entropy decoding, dequantization, predictor-driven reconstruction, and inverse alignment, enabling fast weight materialization for inference. Across Transformer language modeling and vision classification, MCWC improves the rate accuracy Pareto frontier over strong quantization and learned weight-codec baselines, while maintaining competitive decode time. Ablations confirm that alignment, prediction, entropy modeling, and keyframe scheduling are each necessary for the full gains. Our code is available via https://github.com/Ism-ail11/MCWC.

AI.tldr: 提出Motion-Compensated Weight Compression (MCWC)，利用层间置换对称性对齐权重，实现跨层预测和高效压缩，在Transformer和视觉分类任务上优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 神经网络权重日益成为部署瓶颈，现有压缩方法独立处理各层，忽略了由函数保持对称性导致的跨层冗余。
AI.method: MCWC通过对齐置换对称块（如隐藏单元、注意力头）最大化跨层对应；在对齐坐标系中使用轻量级层序预测器（含周期性关键帧），仅编码量化残差；采用基于率失真优化的学习熵模型；解码器通过熵解码、反量化、预测重建和逆对齐快速恢复权重。
AI.result: 在Transformer语言建模和视觉分类任务中，MCWC在率-准确率帕累托前沿上优于强量化基线和学习型权重编码基线，同时保持有竞争力的解码速度。
AI.conclusion: 消融实验证实对齐、预测、熵建模和关键帧调度对完整增益缺一不可。

title: A general tensor-structured compression scheme for efficient large language models
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are dominated by dense linear transformations, whose storage, memory and computational overheads hinder efficient adaptation and deployment while masking the functional impacts of structural simplification. Here we present Tensor Mixture (MixT), a general tensor-structured compression scheme that replaces targeted dense linear layers with natively executable mixtures of tensor operators. Operating directly on generic linear projections instead of model-specific components, MixT is potentially applicable across Transformer-based LLMs and other dense neural mappings. We evaluate MixT on Qwen3-8B and LLaMA2-7B under a unified recovery protocol, identifying a broad compressible regime in which MMLU accuracy is largely preserved before an abrupt transition at model-specific boundaries. This transition coincides with coordinated shifts in output entropy, prediction entropy and inter-layer geometry. At the LLaMA2-7B transition boundary, MixT reduces full-model parameters by 47.5\%, inference FLOPs by 37.1\%, training FLOPs by 52.1\% and peak inference memory by 60.4\%, demonstrating its practical potential for lower-cost LLM compression.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种名为Tensor Mixture (MixT)的张量结构压缩方案，通过将密集线性层替换为可执行的张量算子混合体，在保持模型性能的前提下大幅降低参数和计算开销。在LLaMA2-7B上实现了47.5%的参数压缩和60.4%的推理内存减少。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM中密集线性变换带来了巨大的存储、内存和计算开销，阻碍了高效的模型适配与部署，同时掩盖了结构简化对功能的影响。
AI.method: 提出MixT，一种通用的张量结构压缩方案，将目标密集线性层替换为可直接执行的张量算子混合体，直接作用于通用线性投影而非模型特定组件。
AI.result: 在LLaMA2-7B上，模型参数减少47.5%，推理FLOPs减少37.1%，训练FLOPs减少52.1%，峰值推理内存减少60.4%。在Qwen3-8B和LLaMA2-7B上均存在一个宽泛的可压缩区间，MMLU精度基本保持不变。
AI.conclusion: MixT展示了在低成本LLM压缩方面的实际潜力，能够在不显著损失性能的前提下大幅降低模型参数和计算开销。

title: Fundamental Limitation in Explaining AI
summary: While large-scale models such as LLMs and diffusion models have achieved practical success, public institutions have emphasized the importance of explainability in AI. Existing methods for explaining AI, however, are not designed to provide completely faithful explanations of the behavior of large-scale AI systems. Although a completely faithful and interpretable explanation of the behavior of an AI system might be useful for AI governance, it has not been known whether providing such an explanation is theoretically possible. In this paper, we mathematically prove a fundamental quadrilemma in explaining AI, stating that AI and its explanation cannot satisfy the following four conditions simultaneously: 1) the complexity of the operation environment, 2) the goodness of the AI's performance, 3) the interpretability of the AI's explanation, and 4) the complete faithfulness of the AI's explanation. This quadrilemma suggests that, in most applications where we cannot change the environment or sacrifice good AI performance and an interpretable explanation, we should give up complete faithfulness of explanations and should instead aim to explain only the parts that are important for applications. As a consequence, the quadrilemma implies that AI governance should be designed on the premise that the faithfulness of AI explanations is always incomplete.

AI.tldr: 本文数学证明了解释AI的一个基本四难困境：AI及其解释无法同时满足环境复杂性、AI高性能、解释可解释性和解释完全忠实性这四个条件，这意味着在大多数应用中必须放弃完全忠实的解释。
AI.motivation: 现有AI解释方法无法为大规模AI系统提供完全忠实的解释，而完全忠实且可解释的解释对AI治理至关重要，但此前不知道这种解释在理论上是否可能。
AI.method: 通过数学证明的方式，论证AI系统及其解释存在一个基本四难困境（quadrilemma），即四个条件无法同时满足。
AI.result: 证明了环境复杂性、AI高性能、解释可解释性和解释完全忠实性这四个条件不可兼得。
AI.conclusion: 在大多数应用场景中应放弃完全忠实的解释，转而只解释对应用重要的部分；AI治理应基于AI解释的忠实性总是不完整这一前提来设计。

title: Drift-Resistant Navigation World Model with Anchored Epipolar Guidance
summary: We propose Drift-Resistant Navigation World Model, a generative model that mitigates both perceptual drift and geometric drift in conventional rollout-based navigation world models. Existing methods recursively feed generated content into subsequent steps, causing noise accumulation and degraded predictions, i.e., perceptual drift. Meanwhile, their predictions often deviate from the agent's motion, resulting in geometry drift. We address both types of drift by redesigning world-model prediction as an anchor-guided rollout. Instead of rolling out every frame sequentially, we first predict sparse future anchors that serve as stable long-range targets, and then generate intermediate frames within each chunk conditioned on both past context and future anchors. Importantly, these sparse anchors also provide geometric constraints, supported by bidirectional epipolar geometry, to localize where corresponding content should appear in the intermediate frames. Experiments on four benchmarks demonstrate consistent improvements over strong baselines in long-horizon visual quality, geometric consistency, and multi-view coherence. These gains further translate into improved downstream planning performance under the same planners, highlighting the importance of drift-resistant, geometry-aware prediction for reliable navigation world models.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种抗漂移的导航世界模型（Drift-Resistant Navigation World Model），通过锚点引导的滚动生成方式，同时缓解了感知漂移和几何漂移问题，在多个基准测试中提升了视觉质量、几何一致性和下游规划性能。
AI.motivation: 现有基于滚动生成的导航世界模型存在两类漂移问题：一是递归生成导致噪声累积的感知漂移；二是预测偏离智能体真实运动的几何漂移。这些漂移严重影响了长期预测的可靠性和后续规划性能。
AI.method: 提出锚点引导的滚动生成策略：先预测稀疏的未来锚点作为长期稳定目标，再在相邻锚点间的分块内生成中间帧，使生成过程同时受过去上下文和未来锚点约束。此外，利用双向对极几何提供几何约束，确保中间帧中对应内容的准确位置。
AI.result: 在四个基准测试上，该方法在长期视觉质量、几何一致性和多视图一致性方面均显著优于强基线模型，并且提升了下游规划性能。
AI.conclusion: 抗漂移且具备几何感知能力的预测对于构建可靠的导航世界模型至关重要，本文方法有效提升了长时程预测的鲁棒性和规划实用性。

title: AI-Associated Lexical Shifts Across 34 Languages: Cross-Lingual Convergence and Diachronic Uptake in News Writing
comment: 19 pages (9-page main body, plus references and appendices), 3 figures; ACL ARR reviewed, committed to EMNLP 2026
summary: AI-associated lexical shifts have been documented mainly in Scientific English. We extend this work to 34 languages in the WMT News Crawl corpus, refining a split-halves continuation diagnostic that compares GPT-4.1 continuations with matched human gold-standard text. For each language, we derive ranked AI-overused lemmas using log prevalence ratios. We find substantial cross-lingual semantic convergence: semantically related concepts recur across typologically diverse languages, with 'emphasize'-type verbs appearing in 24 of 34 languages. Embedding-based and manual analyses support this pattern. We also examine diachronic uptake in news writing before and after ChatGPT's release. Tracking each language's top 20 AI-overused items, we find prevalence increases in 26 of 34 languages from 2020-2021 to 2023-2024, with a mean change of +15.1%, whilst matched baseline words show no comparable increase (-4.5%). In 10 languages with longer historical coverage, longitudinal analyses show post-2022 increases that exceed the modest shifts observed in earlier periods, though with smaller effect sizes than in Scientific English. We validate our approach extensively, including across seeds, model variants, data sizes, model families, and more. Our findings are consistent with the view that AI-associated lexical preferences extend beyond English and may exert cross-lingual homogenising pressure on global language use.

AI.tldr: 本研究将AI相关词汇偏移的分析从科学英语扩展到34种语言，发现AI使用存在跨语言语义趋同现象，并在ChatGPT发布后26种语言的新闻写作中观察到AI过度使用词汇的显著增长（平均+15.1%），表明AI可能对全球语言使用产生跨语言的同质化压力。
AI.motivation: 此前AI相关词汇偏移研究主要集中于科学英语，缺乏对多语言、跨语言场景的系统性分析，无法判断AI对全球语言使用的广泛影响。
AI.method: 使用WMT News Crawl语料库覆盖34种语言，采用分半延续诊断方法比较GPT-4.1输出与人类金标准文本，通过对数流行率比（log prevalence ratios）提取每种语言中AI过度使用的词汇，并结合嵌入分析和人工分析验证跨语言语义趋同。
AI.result: 1）跨语言语义趋同显著，'强调'类动词在24/34种语言中共同出现；2）26/34种语言在ChatGPT发布后AI过度使用词汇流行率上升（平均+15.1%），而基线词汇下降（-4.5%）；3）10种语言的纵向分析显示2022年后增长超过此前时期，但效应量小于科学英语。
AI.conclusion: AI相关的词汇偏好不仅限于英语，可能对全球语言使用施加跨语言的同质化压力。

title: Hylos: Operability Contracts for Model-Native Spatial Intelligence
comment: 27 pages, 7 figures. Systems/position preprint with focused artifact study
summary:
Foundation models can increasingly describe, reconstruct, and generate 3D objects, assemblies, scenes, and environments, but visually plausible spatial output is not yet operable 3D. A generated object or environment becomes useful to an agent only when the system can identify its entities, frames, surfaces, constraints, provenance, admissible actions, expected effects, and validation failures.
  This paper introduces Hylos, a systems architecture for contract-bounded spatial intelligence. Hylos maintains scene-scale operability state over objects, assemblies, assets, surface anchors, assertions, action candidates, solver jobs, shared actuator invocations, capability gaps, and effect diffs. Durable spatial changes are routed through a SpatialTransaction: a commit boundary that resolves references, checks admissibility, protects invariants, projects effects, and returns commit, review, rollback, deferral, or capability-gap outcomes.
  The paper is framed as a systems/position preprint with a focused artifact study rather than a broad benchmark. The study examines causal repair: a visible misalignment appears on a dependent component, while the supported repair lies upstream in the placement structure that controls it. The successful interaction traces the symptom through scene dependencies, selects a supported upstream interaction, and applies a validated change instead of directly editing visible geometry.
  The broader claim is that spatial AI should be evaluated not only by visual quality, but by whether generated or edited 3D can become reliable substrate for CAD, robotics, simulation, inspection, manufacturing, and interactive world authoring.

AI.tldr: Hylos是一个用于合约约束空间智能的系统架构，通过空间事务机制确保3D生成的输出不仅是视觉合理的，而且是可操作、可验证的，支持CAD、机器人、仿真等工程应用。论文通过因果修复案例展示了该系统的有效性。
AI.motivation: 当前基础模型可生成视觉上合理的3D内容，但这些输出对智能体而言并不可操作——系统无法识别实体、框架、表面、约束、来源、可执行动作、预期效果及验证失败原因。因此需要一种确保3D内容可操作性的系统架构。
AI.method: 提出Hylos系统架构，核心组件包括：(1) 场景级可操作状态管理（对象、装配体、表面锚点、断言、动作候选等）；(2) SpatialTransaction（空间事务）作为提交边界，负责解析引用、检查可接纳性、保护不变量、投影效果，返回提交/审查/回滚/延迟/能力缺口等结果。
AI.result: 通过因果修复案例研究验证：当依赖组件出现可见错位时，系统能够通过场景依赖关系追踪症状，选择上游支持性交互，应用经过验证的变更，而非直接编辑可见几何体。成功实现了因果链的追溯与修复。
AI.conclusion: 空间AI的评估不应仅关注视觉质量，还应考察生成或编辑的3D内容是否能成为CAD、机器人、仿真、检测、制造和交互式世界创作的可靠基础。Hylos为此提供了一种系统架构方案。

title: 4KLSDB: A Large-Scale Dataset for 4K Image Restoration and Generation
comment: Accepted to the DataCV Workshop at CVPR 2026; 10 pages, 4 figures, 7 tables; Our project page is available at: https://4klsdb.github.io/
summary: High-resolution datasets are essential for advancing super-resolution (SR) and text-to-image (T2I) diffusion research. However, current publicly available datasets lack both the native 4K resolution and the extensive scale necessary for training state-of-the-art models. To address this gap, we introduce a 4K Large Scale Dataset and Benchmark (4KLSDB), a large-scale, diverse dataset consisting of 129,484 carefully curated 4K resolution images spanning multiple categories such as nature, urban scenes, people, food, artwork, and CGI, alongside distinct validation and test sets containing 2,000 and 1,984 images respectively. Images were sourced from established open datasets including Photo Concept Bucket, Laion2B, and PD12M. 4KLSDB underwent rigorous multi-stage automated filtering and annotation pipelines involving both human annotators and Large Multimodal Models (LMMs) to ensure high aesthetic quality and dataset consistency. We demonstrate 4KLSDB's effectiveness by training representative super-resolution and diffusion models, observing significant improvements in performance on native 4K benchmarks. Comprehensive experiments illustrate a positive correlation between training on true 4K resolution data and improved fidelity in image restoration task, especially on 4K resolution. We provide the research community a valuable resource to drive progress toward genuinely high-fidelity image synthesis and restoration by providing 4KLSDB. Our project page is available at: https://4klsdb.github.io/.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了4KLSDB，一个包含129,484张4K分辨率图像的大规模数据集，并通过实验证明使用真实4K数据训练能显著提升超分辨率和文本到图像扩散模型的性能。
AI.motivation: 现有公开数据集缺乏原生4K分辨率和大规模样本量，无法支撑当前先进超分辨率和T2I扩散模型的训练需求。
AI.method: 从Photo Concept Bucket、Laion2B、PD12M等开源数据集中收集图像，经过多阶段自动过滤和人工+大语言模型联合标注，构建了129,484张4K图像及对应的验证/测试集。
AI.result: 在4K基准测试上，使用4KLSDB训练的SR和扩散模型性能显著提升，且真实4K分辨率数据与图像保真度之间存在正相关关系。
AI.conclusion: 4KLSDB为社区提供了推动高保真图像合成与修复研究的重要资源。

title: Learning to Route Languages for Multilingual Policy Optimization
summary: Large language models~(LLMs) are trained on heterogeneous multilingual corpora, yet existing policy optimization methods often implicitly restrict each training question to a single response language or rely on a fixed dominant language for supervision. We propose language-routed policy optimization (LRPO), an online policy optimization framework that treats language as a selectable variable. LRPO elicits multilingual rollouts for each training question and integrates their relative quality into preference-based policy updates, increasing the diversity and informativeness of training signals under the fixed rollout budget. To adaptively determine which languages to explore during reinforcement learning, we introduce a trainable language router formulated as a multi-armed bandit, balancing exploration of underutilized languages with exploitation of more informative ones. Extensive experiments show that LRPO consistently improves multilingual performance, demonstrating that adaptive language routing enables effective cross-lingual knowledge exploitation for training. We release all the resources at https://github.com/Guochry/LRPO.

AI.tldr: 本文提出语言路由策略优化（LRPO），一种在线策略优化框架，将语言视为可选变量，通过多臂老虎机自适应选择探索语言，在固定预算下提升多语言训练效果。
AI.motivation: 现有策略优化方法通常隐式地将每个训练问题限制为单一响应语言，或依赖于固定的主导语言进行监督，忽略了多语言语料库的异构性，限制了跨语言知识的利用。
AI.method: 提出LRPO框架：1）对每个训练问题生成多语言rollout；2）将各语言响应的相对质量融入基于偏好的策略更新；3）引入基于多臂老虎机的可训练语言路由器，自适应平衡探索未充分利用的语言与利用信息量更大的语言。
AI.result: 大量实验表明，LRPO在多语言性能上持续提升，证明了自适应语言路由能够有效利用跨语言知识进行训练。
AI.conclusion: 自适应语言路由策略可以有效提升大语言模型的多语言训练效果，资源已开源。

title: Leveraging pretrained RGB denoisers for hyperspectral image restoration
summary: Hyperspectral image restoration faces several challenges, including limited training data, strong sensor specificity, and high spectral dimensionality. These limitations hinder the learning of robust hyperspectral priors, motivating the reuse of priors learned from large-scale RGB data. In this work, we propose a minimally trained, lightweight adapter that repurposes frozen pretrained RGB denoisers for hyperspectral restoration through a projection mapping. The method denoises low-dimensional spectral projections and reconstructs the hyperspectral cube through constrained linear aggregation, while preserving plug-and-play compatibility and the stability properties of the underlying RGB denoiser. Experiments on denoising, deblurring, and super-resolution across multiple datasets demonstrate consistent improvements over hyperspectral-specific baselines, showing the strong transferability of large-scale RGB priors.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种轻量级适配器，通过投影映射将预训练的RGB去噪器复用于高光谱图像恢复，在少量训练下实现优于专用方法的性能。
AI.motivation: 高光谱图像恢复面临训练数据有限、传感器特异性强、光谱维度高等挑战，难以学习鲁棒的高光谱先验，因此希望复用大规模RGB数据中学到的先验知识。
AI.method: 提出一种轻量级适配器，对低维光谱投影进行去噪，通过约束线性聚合重建高光谱立方体，保持即插即用兼容性和底层RGB去噪器的稳定性。
AI.result: 在去噪、去模糊和超分辨率等多个数据集上，该方法一致优于高光谱专用基线方法。
AI.conclusion: 大规模RGB先验具有很强的可迁移性，可有效辅助高光谱图像恢复任务。

title: EfficientGraph-RAG: Structured Retrieval-State Management for Cross-Task Retrieval-Augmented Generation
summary: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) has become the standard way to ground large language models in external knowledge, but many systems still organize evidence as flat chunks and retrieve it through largely unstructured search. This weak structure becomes a bottleneck for complex retrieval: the system must decide where to search, how to move from coarse topics to entity-relation evidence, which evidence has been verified, and which intermediate artifacts can be reused. We define these intermediate variables as a retrieval state and study RAG as structured state management. EfficientGraph-RAG makes this state explicit through three coupled mechanisms: TAM defines a typed hierarchical state space over evidence, MARS updates and verifies the state through role-specialized agents, and SMP stores reusable state under hierarchy-aware access control. Using one shared framework configuration, EfficientGraph-RAG ranks first on the reported answer-quality metrics averaged over the three evaluated LongBench retrieval-style subsets, matches the strongest agentic baseline on HotpotQA EM while reducing large-model token usage by $3.51\times$, and provides a low-token DocVQA result among retrieval-organizing cross-modal methods. Component analysis shows role-specific mechanisms: MARS is the main answer-quality driver, TAM supplies the typed traversal state and Adaptive Routing signal, and SMP enables corpus-dependent reuse, with cross-query cache hit rates ranging from 3.77% to 23.18%.

AI.tldr: 本文提出EfficientGraph-RAG，通过定义检索状态并利用TAM（类型化层次状态空间）、MARS（角色专业化智能体更新验证）和SMP（可复用状态存储）三个机制，将RAG从非结构化检索转化为结构化状态管理，在多项基准上取得领先性能。
AI.motivation: 现有RAG系统将证据组织为扁平块并通过非结构化检索，在复杂检索任务中面临搜索定位、粗粒度到细粒度证据转换、验证和复用等瓶颈，缺乏对中间检索变量的显式状态管理。
AI.method: 提出三种耦合机制：TAM定义类型化层次状态空间；MARS通过角色专业化智能体更新和验证状态；SMP存储可复用状态并实现层次感知的访问控制。
AI.result: 在LongBench检索子集上平均排名第一；在HotpotQA上匹配最强智能体基线并减少3.51倍大模型token用量；在DocVQA上达到低token消耗的跨模态检索结果。跨查询缓存命中率3.77%~23.18%。
AI.conclusion: 将RAG建模为结构化的状态管理是提升检索质量和效率的有效范式，MARS是答案质量的主要驱动因素，TAM提供类型化遍历状态，SMP实现语料依赖的复用。

title: Proper Scoring Rules for Agentic Uncertainty Quantification
summary: Language-model agents increasingly emit uncertainty signals throughout a trajectory, but existing agentic UQ evaluations often conflate ranking usefulness with probabilistic truthfulness. AUROC, AUPRC, risk-coverage, Trajectory ECE, and scalarized trajectory scores evaluate discrimination, binwise calibration, or collapsed summaries, but do not strictly elicit the full prefix-conditioned success-probability trace $q_t = P^π(Y=1 | H_t)$. Building on prequential proper scoring, we introduce the Trajectory Proper Score (TPS), a predictor-agnostic family of strictly proper trajectory-level scoring rules for any per-step uncertainty signal calibrated into a probability of eventual success. We prove that TPS strictly elicits the success-probability process under complete observation, within the chosen score family and weight schedule. We extend the construction to administratively censored trajectories by projecting the complete-data score onto the observable stopped prefix, yielding an exact $q_Z$-weighted reduced score and a tractable approximation when $q_Z$ is unestimated. We further show that common trajectory evaluators target weaker objects than the full prefix-conditioned probability process: Trajectory ECE is resolution-blind, while scalarized Trajectory Brier elicits only the collapsed scalar, not the full trace. Experiments on StrategyQA, Tau2-Bench, HotpotQA, and WebShop show that these theoretical distinctions are operationally visible: probability recalibration can substantially change TPS while leaving rank metrics nearly unchanged, and the tractable censored approximation can change the verdict relative to complete-only evaluation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出轨迹恰当分数（TPS），一种用于严格评估语言模型代理在轨迹层面不确定性信号的评分规则，能够完整捕捉前缀条件下的成功概率过程。
AI.motivation: 现有代理不确定性评估方法（如AUROC、AUPRC、轨迹ECE等）混淆了排序有用性与概率真实性，无法严格评估完整的前缀条件成功概率轨迹。
AI.method: 基于预序恰当评分理论，构建了轨迹恰当的评分规则族（TPS），证明了其在完全观测下严格启发成功概率过程；并扩展至删失轨迹场景，通过投影完整数据分数到可观测停止前缀，得到精确的q_Z加权简化分数及可计算近似。
AI.result: 理论上证明了轨迹ECE分辨率不足、标量化轨迹Brier仅启发坍缩标量而非完整轨迹；实验上（StrategyQA、Tau2-Bench等）显示概率重校准可显著改变TPS但几乎不影响排序指标，删失近似可能改变评估结论。
AI.conclusion: TPS提供了一种更严格、更完整的代理不确定性评估框架，揭示了现有指标的理论缺陷并在实践中可观测到显著差异。

title: AuthTrace: Diagnosing Evidence Construction in Thematically Dense Single-Author Corpora
summary: Evidence construction systems--chunk retrieval, agent memory, knowledge-graph traversal, and thematic indexing--are evaluated on separate benchmarks with incompatible corpora and metrics, making cross-paradigm diagnosis impossible. We introduce AuthTrace, the first diagnostic benchmark that places all major paradigms on a single corpus and query set by exploiting the dual nature of single-author collections. Built on thematically dense corpora where all texts share style, topic, and vocabulary, AuthTrace provides 2,099 instances with exhaustive gold evidence and a fan-in gradient as the primary diagnostic axis. Comparing eight systems across two QA models, we find that (1) evidence recall--not precision--is the dominant predictor of answer quality (r = 0.96); (2) fan-in exposes paradigm-specific collapse patterns, with flat retrieval degrading 3x faster than structured-evidence systems; and (3) full-context prompting fails uniformly, establishing evidence construction as a necessary capacity beyond raw corpus exposure.

AI.tldr: 提出AuthTrace基准，统一评估证据构建系统，发现证据召回（而非精确度）是答案质量的主导预测因子，且不同范式在扇入梯度下表现出特定崩溃模式。
AI.motivation: 现有证据构建系统（如分块检索、智能体记忆、知识图谱遍历、主题索引）在各自独立的基准上评估，使用不兼容的语料库和指标，导致无法跨范式进行诊断和比较。
AI.method: 利用单一作者作品的双重性（主题密度高、风格/主题/词汇一致），构建AuthTrace基准，包含2,099个实例及详尽黄金证据，以扇入梯度作为核心诊断轴，对八种系统、两种QA模型进行对比。
AI.result: (1) 证据召回（而非精确度）是答案质量的主要预测因子（r=0.96）；(2) 扇入暴露了范式特定的崩溃模式，平面检索的退化速度是结构化证据系统的3倍；(3) 全上下文提示在所有情况下均失败。
AI.conclusion: 证据构建是超越原始语料暴露的必要能力，不同范式在高扇入场景下表现差异显著，结构化证据系统更具鲁棒性。

title: Uncertainty Decomposition via Cyclical SG-MCMC and Soft-label Learning for Subjective NLP
summary: Annotator disagreement in emotion classification reflects ambiguity intrinsic to emotion concepts and is essential for predictor-quality assessment in subjective NLP. Yet no prior work integrates soft-label learning with Bayesian deep learning to evaluate uncertainty along axes including annotator-distribution fidelity. We train a linear head on a frozen RoBERTa via cyclical stochastic gradient Markov chain Monte Carlo (cSG-MCMC), targeting the empirical annotator distribution with a soft-label objective under a five-axis evaluation. On the 28-emotion GoEmotions benchmark, the proposed method outperforms Monte Carlo Dropout and Deep Ensemble simultaneously on three axes -- Jensen-Shannon divergence (JSD) to the annotator distribution, Spearman correlation between per-emotion aleatoric uncertainty and disagreement, and selective-prediction Area Under the Risk-Coverage Curve (AURC) and Area Under the ROC Curve (AUROC) -- showing independent axes are jointly attainable from one posterior. Post-hoc temperature scaling exhibits a bidirectional effect, establishing hard-label calibration and annotator-JSD as independent dimensions and motivating joint reporting as an honest protocol.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种结合软标签学习与贝叶斯深度学习的情绪分类方法，在GoEmotions基准上实现了更好的不确定性评估与预测质量。
AI.motivation: 情绪分类中标注者分歧反映了情绪概念的固有歧义性，但已有工作未能将软标签学习与贝叶斯深度学习相结合，以评估多维度下的不确定性。
AI.method: 在冻结的RoBERTa上训练线性头，使用循环随机梯度马尔可夫链蒙特卡洛（cSG-MCMC），以软标签目标优化经验标注者分布，并在五轴评估框架下进行评价。
AI.result: 在28类GoEmotions基准上，该方法在JSD、Spearman相关性和选择性预测AURC/AUROC三个轴上同时优于MC Dropout和Deep Ensemble。
AI.conclusion: 后验分布可同时实现多个独立评估轴；温度缩放对硬标签校准和标注者JSD具有双向影响，建议联合报告作为更诚实的评估协议。

title: PRIMA: Operational Patterns for Resilient Multi-Agent Research with Verifiable Identity and Convergent Feedback
comment: 11 pages. Single-author preprint. Supplementary case-study report (Graph Isomorphism algorithm proposal with three theorems, five conjectures, complete complexity analysis, and hard-instance evaluation) available at https://spockstein.github.io/prima/case-study-graph-isomorphism.html
summary: Operating LLMs as coordinated multi-agent research systems over multi-hour runs surfaces failure modes that single-shot evaluation cannot: upstream providers throttle without warning, sub-agents drift the task to fit accessible tools, narrate machinery instead of using it, open revision iterations with self-apology, or treat upstream context as executable directives. We present PRIMA, whose primary contributions are three operational patterns for surviving these failure modes: (1) a resilience-and-recovery layer that detects upstream rate-limit signals, persists a typed pause record to disk, and resumes long-running runs without re-executing converged work even across process restarts; (2) a sub-agent operating discipline encoding task-fidelity, tool-use, revision, and inter-step context-boundary norms as a structural prompt layer; (3) a multi-phase application pattern for structured engineering deliverables pairing orthogonal draft steps with an explicit cross-document harmonization pass before final synthesis. These sit atop a foundational protocol: a research-program specification language with explicit convergence criteria, a dual-metric scoring engine (LLM-judged rubric plus sandboxed code), an outer meta-optimization loop, event-driven persistence, hook-based middleware, context compaction, and a multi-provider LLM abstraction. Agent identities derive from prime powers, giving collision-free identifiers and trivially-verifiable cluster membership without a central registry. Theoretical guarantees include $O(k)$ verification, $O(V+E)$ DAG validation, and identity collision freedom by the Fundamental Theorem of Arithmetic. A Graph Isomorphism case study grounds the architectural claims in a generated artifact: a six-step protocol that produced a research paper proposing a new canonical-form algorithm with three theorems and five conjectures.

AI.tldr: PRIMA提出了一种面向长时间运行的多智能体LLM系统的运行模式，通过弹性恢复层、子智能体操作规范和多阶段应用模式，解决了单次评估无法捕获的系统性故障模式（如限流、任务漂移、工具误用等），并在图同构案例研究中生成了包含三定理五猜想的论文。
AI.motivation: 长时间运行的多智能体LLM系统存在单次评估无法捕获的故障模式（如上游限流、子任务漂移、工具误用等），需要系统性解决方案。
AI.method: 提出三种运行模式：(1)弹性恢复层，检测限流信号并持久化暂停记录以实现断点续跑；(2)子智能体操作规范，通过结构化提示层编码任务保真度、工具使用、修订和上下文边界规范；(3)多阶段应用模式，分离正交草稿步骤与跨文档协调阶段。底层协议包括研究程序规范语言、双指标评分引擎、元优化循环、事件驱动持久化、钩子中间件、上下文压缩和多提供者LLM抽象。智能体身份基于素数幂。
AI.result: 图同构案例研究生成了一个六步协议，产出一篇提出新规范形式算法的研究论文，包含三个定理和五个猜想。理论保证包括O(k)验证、O(V+E) DAG验证以及基于算术基本定理的身份无冲突性。
AI.conclusion: PRIMA通过精心设计的运行模式与底层协议，有效应对了长时间多智能体系统的关键故障模式，并在真实研究案例中验证了其生成结构化工程交付物的能力。

title: GRAIL: AI translation for scientists application workflow on satellite data
summary: Domain scientists increasingly develop Python scripts to analyze satellite imagery but they lack scalability to large-scale data. This paper demonstrates GRAIL, an agentic translation system that converts Python geospatial workflows into executable Spark-based programs without requiring scientists to learn a new framework. Rather than fine-tuning a specialized LLM model, GRAIL adapts RDPro, a Scala library for satellite data analysis, to make it LLM-ready using structured documentation, API alias functions, and repair-oriented error logs. Translation is structured as a LangGraph pipeline that decomposes code generation into explicit sections with guided inputs and outputs, enabling targeted repair without regenerating the full program. We demonstrate GRAIL on real-world geospatial workflows and showcase the correctness and scalability of the translated code.

AI.tldr: GRAIL是一个智能体翻译系统，可将Python地理空间工作流自动转换为可执行的Spark程序，无需科学家学习新框架。
AI.motivation: 领域科学家使用Python脚本分析卫星图像，但缺乏大规模数据处理的扩展能力。
AI.method: 通过结构化文档、API别名函数和修复导向的错误日志使Scala库RDPro适配LLM；采用LangGraph流水线将代码生成分解为显式模块，实现定向修复而不需重新生成完整程序。
AI.result: 在真实地理空间工作流上展示了翻译后代码的正确性和可扩展性。
AI.conclusion: GRAIL无需微调专用LLM即可实现Python到Spark的高质量代码翻译。

title: LLM-as-a-Reviewer: Benchmarking Their Ability, Divergence, and Prompt Injection Resistance as Paper Reviewers
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used in academic peer review, yet their reliability, alignment with human judgment, and robustness to adversarial attacks remain poorly understood. We present a systematic benchmark of LLM-as-a-Reviewer on 898 papers stratified from NeurIPS and ICLR, evaluating 12 LLMs along three axes: rating calibration, divergence from human reviewers, and resistance to prompt injection embedded via an invisible font-mapping attack. We find that LLMs systematically overrate weaker submissions and diverge from humans in topical emphasis, under-flagging Clarity and over-flagging Reproducibility, while producing reviews two to three times longer with lower lexical diversity and a more standardized vocabulary. Prompt injection remains highly effective. Simple hidden instructions can promote low-scoring papers to acceptance-level ratings in a substantial fraction of cases, with effectiveness varying sharply across model families. While LLMs offer utility in structuring evaluations, their integration into peer review requires safeguards against both intrinsic biases and adversarial risks.

AI.tldr: 系统评估了12种LLM作为学术评审员的表现，发现它们倾向于高估弱投稿，与人类评审存在主题偏差，生成更长但词汇更多样性更低的评审，且容易受到隐藏字体攻击的提示注入影响。
AI.motivation: 大型语言模型在学术同行评审中的应用日益增多，但其可靠性、与人类判断的一致性以及对抗攻击的鲁棒性尚不明确，缺乏系统性评估。
AI.method: 构建了包含898篇来自NeurIPS和ICLR论文的LLM-as-a-Reviewer基准，从评分校准、与人类评审的分歧、对不可见字体映射攻击的提示注入抵抗力三个维度评估了12种LLM。
AI.result: LLM系统性地高估弱投稿；与人类在主题侧重上存在分歧（低估清晰度、高估可重复性）；生成2-3倍更长但词汇多样性更低的评审；提示注入攻击仍然非常有效，简单隐藏指令可使低分论文在相当比例案例中达到录取级别评分。
AI.conclusion: LLM在结构化评审方面有实用价值，但其融入同行评审需要针对内在偏见和对抗风险建立防护措施。

title: PANDO: Efficient Multimodal AI Agents via Online Skill Distillation
summary: Recent advances in multimodal web agents often rely on increased inference-time computation, including rollout search, verifier passes, offline skill discovery, and specialist model stacks. This raises a central question: can a web agent become more efficient as it accumulates experience, rather than more expensive? We first analyze trajectories from VisualWebArena and identify three recurring sources of inefficiency: repeat-action loops, hidden discovery costs, and low prompt-cache reuse. We then introduce PANDO, a single-rollout online skill-distillation framework that maintains a structured Skill Library and combines progress reflection, confidence-based skill demotion, hierarchical routing, visual compression, and cache-aware prompting. On the full set of 910 VisualWebArena tasks, PANDO achieves a 58.3% success rate, outperforming SGV (54.0%) and our WALT reproduction (45.2%), while using 58% fewer tokens than SGV and 61% fewer tokens than WALT, without any pre-evaluation discovery budget. A 300-task ablation further shows that rules and routines provide most of the success gains, while routing, compression, and cache-aware prompting convert the larger skill library into lower marginal token cost. Finally, we introduce three trajectory-level efficiency metrics -- Action Repetition Rate, Step Overhead Ratio, and Prompt Cache Utilization -- to make efficiency visible beyond terminal success.

AI.tldr: PANDO是一个单次 rollout 的在线技能蒸馏框架，通过结构化技能库、进度反思、置信度降级、分层路由、视觉压缩和缓存感知提示，在 VisualWebArena 上以更少 token 实现更高成功率（58.3% vs SGV 54.0%），并提出了三种轨迹级效率指标。
AI.motivation: 现有多模态网络代理依赖增加推理时计算（如 rollout 搜索、验证器、离线技能发现等）提升性能，导致成本随经验增长而增加。作者探究能否让代理随着经验积累变得更高效而非更昂贵，并识别出三个低效来源：重复动作循环、隐藏发现成本和低提示缓存复用。
AI.method: 提出 PANDO 框架，包含：(1) 结构化技能库，(2) 进度反思，(3) 置信度驱动的技能降级，(4) 分层路由，(5) 视觉压缩，(6) 缓存感知提示。采用单次 rollout 的在线技能蒸馏方式。
AI.result: 在 910 个 VisualWebArena 任务上，PANDO 成功率达 58.3%，优于 SGV（54.0%）和 WALT（45.2%）；同时比 SGV 节省 58% token，比 WALT 节省 61% token，且无需预评估发现预算。300 任务消融实验显示规则和例程贡献了主要的成功提升。
AI.conclusion: 提出三种轨迹级效率指标（动作重复率、步骤开销比、提示缓存利用率），使效率可衡量。证明通过结构化技能积累和缓存感知设计，代理可以随经验增长变得更高效而非更昂贵。

title: DUEL: Adversarial Self-Play for Multimodal Reasoning
summary: Reinforcement learning (RL) has emerged as an effective paradigm for improving the reasoning capability of vision-language models (VLMs). However, RL-based optimization typically depends on costly high-quality annotations that are difficult to scale. Existing unsupervised alternatives may drift toward biased solutions due to weak visual grounding and the lack of reliable verification signals. We propose a self-evolving post-training framework, DUEL, where supervision emerges from adversarial interactions between two policies initialized from the same pretrained VLM. A Challenger generates an image-grounded true claim together with a minimally perturbed hard-negative counterpart, while a Solver verifies both claims against the image, encouraging fine-grained visual discrimination under near-neighbor semantics. To stabilize optimization, we introduce a length-normalized log-likelihood reward that preserves informative optimization signals beyond binary outcome supervision and improves learning stability under sparse feedback. Experiments show that DUEL consistently improves visual reasoning and robust discrimination without additional human annotations, external reward models, or image editing tools.

AI.tldr: 提出自我进化的后训练框架DUEL，通过两个策略网络的对抗交互生成监督信号，无需人工标注即可提升视觉语言模型的推理与辨别能力。
AI.motivation: 现有RL优化依赖昂贵的高质量标注，无监督方法因弱视觉基础和缺乏可靠验证信号容易产生偏解。
AI.method: DUEL包含Challenger（生成真实陈述与硬负样本）和Solver（验证两者的图像对齐性），并使用长度归一化的对数似然奖励来稳定优化。
AI.result: 在无需人工标注、外部奖励模型或图像编辑工具的情况下，持续提升视觉推理和鲁棒辨别能力。
AI.conclusion: 对抗性交互生成的监督信号能有效替代人工标注，推动VLM的后训练朝着自我演进的方向发展。

title: SomaliBench Eval: Measuring English-to-Somali Refusal Gaps in Open-Weight Language Models
summary: Large language model safety evaluation remains heavily English-centered, leaving low-resource languages under-measured even when models are deployed globally. We evaluate four open-weight instruction-tuned models on SomaliBench v0, a native-author-verified benchmark of 100 harmful-intent prompts paired across English and Somali. Each of Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct, Gemma-2-9B-Instruct, Qwen-2.5-7B-Instruct, and Aya-23-8B is run locally with temperature 0 and the same English "helpful, harmless, and honest" (HHH) system prompt. A pinned Claude Sonnet snapshot (claude-sonnet-4-5-20250929) classifies each response as refused, complied, or unclear; the native author spot-checks a stratified 80-row sample. We find large English-to-Somali refusal gaps for all four models: Llama-3.1-8B (0.90; 95% bootstrap CI [0.85, 0.96]), Aya-23-8B (0.75 [0.67, 0.83]), Qwen-2.5-7B (0.69 [0.59, 0.78]), and Gemma-2-9B (0.38 [0.27, 0.49]). For three models, the dominant Somali non-refusal mode is not fluent harmful compliance but unclear output: empty, wrong-language, or incoherent generations. The native verification spot-check achieves 100% agreement with the judge (Cohen's kappa = 1.00) on the 80 sampled rows. We report aggregate refusal rates, category gaps, and reliability statistics only; raw model generations are retained locally and are not released.

AI.tldr: 该研究评估了四个开源指令微调模型在英语和索马里语上的安全拒绝率，发现所有模型在索马里语上的拒绝率均显著低于英语，且索马里语的非拒绝输出多为不清晰的回应（空白、错误语言或语无伦次）。
AI.motivation: 大型语言模型的安全评估主要集中在英语上，低资源语言的安全评测严重不足，但模型却在全球范围部署。作者旨在填补这一空白，评估模型在低资源语言（索马里语）上的安全表现。
AI.method: 构建了索马里语基准（SomaliBench v0），包含100对英语-索马里语有害意图提示，由母语者验证。对四个开源模型（Llama-3.1-8B、Gemma-2-9B、Qwen-2.5-7B、Aya-23-8B）使用相同HHH系统提示、temperature=0进行本地推理，用Claude Sonnet分类回应，并由母语作者抽检80行样本进行验证。
AI.result: 所有模型均存在显著的英语到索马里语拒绝率差距：Llama-3.1-8B差距0.90，Aya-23-8B差距0.75，Qwen-2.5-7B差距0.69，Gemma-2-9B差距0.38。索马里语中非拒绝回应多为不清晰输出（空白、错误语言或语无伦次）。母语验证与自动分类完全一致（Cohen's kappa = 1.00）。
AI.conclusion: 当前主流指令微调模型在低资源语言上的安全对齐存在严重缺口，即便模型输出未直接有害，不清晰的回应本身也构成安全隐患。需要更多关注低资源语言的安全评估。

title: CoRe-Code: Collaborative Reinforcement Learning for Code Generation
summary: Large language models (LLMs) have achieved strong performance in code generation, but most methods rely on autoregressive decoding without global planning, often leading to locally coherent yet globally suboptimal solutions (e.g., failing test cases or inefficient complexity). While recent approaches such as Chain-of-Thought (CoT) and multi-agent systems (MAS) introduce planning, their limited role specialization and coordination hinder performance on complex tasks. To address the challenges of coordination and specialization in multi-agent code generation, we propose Collaborative Reinforcement Code (CoRe-Code), a framework for role specialized LLM agents that enhances inter-agent coordination to generate more accurate and efficient code. CoRe-Code adopts a simple Planner-Coder paradigm, where the Planner produces high-level plans and the Coder executes them to generate code. We further introduce a collaboration-aware reinforcement learning stage based on Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) to enhance role specialization and alignment. Experiments show that CoRe-Code outperforms a wide range of existing RL-based and multi-agent methods. In addition, we demonstrate that CoRe-Code can generalize to other multi-agent frameworks (e.g., Retrieval and Debugging agents), highlighting its flexibility and scalability. We evaluate CoRe-Code on multiple benchmarks of varying difficulty using three base models. Compared to existing baselines, the results show consistent improvements in accuracy, while also achieving higher efficiency in terms of execution time and memory usage, demonstrating the effectiveness and practicality of CoRe-Code.

AI.tldr: CoRe-Code是一个基于强化学习的多智能体协作代码生成框架，采用Planner-Coder范式，通过GRPO增强角色分工与协调，在多个基准测试中显著优于现有方法，兼顾准确性与效率。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM代码生成方法缺乏全局规划，且多智能体方法角色分工与协调不足，导致复杂任务表现不佳。
AI.method: 提出Planner-Coder双角色框架，Planner负责高层规划，Coder负责代码实现；并引入基于GRPO的协作感知强化学习阶段，增强角色专化与对齐。
AI.result: 在多个不同难度的基准测试上，使用三种基础模型，CoRe-Code在准确率、执行时间和内存使用上均优于现有RL方法和多智能体方法，且能泛化到其他多智能体框架。
AI.conclusion: CoRe-Code有效提升了多智能体代码生成的准确性与效率，展示了良好的灵活性、可扩展性和实用性。

title: HCL-FF: Hierarchical and Contrastive Learning for Forward-Forward Algorithm
summary: Deep neural networks trained with backpropagation have achieved outstanding performance in vision tasks but remain biologically implausible, computationally demanding, and difficult to interpret. The Forward-Forward (FF) algorithm offers a promising alternative by training each layer independently through local goodness objectives. However, its purely local optimization lacks hierarchical coordination across layers, and the decoupling of goodness from features leaves the representations unconstrained and semantically ambiguous. We propose a Hierarchical and Contrastive Learning FF framework (HCL-FF) to address these limitations. HCL-FF introduces (1) a coarse-to-fine hierarchical learning strategy that guides representations from low-level cues to high-level semantics, and (2) a supervised contrastive objective that enforces class-discriminative alignment after goodness decoupling. Experiments on CIFAR-10, CIFAR-100, and Tiny-ImageNet demonstrate that HCL-FF achieves new state-of-the-art performance among FF-based methods, with notable accuracy gains of +5.46%, +17.00%, and +12.51%, respectively.

AI.tldr: 本文提出HCL-FF框架，通过分层对比学习改进Forward-Forward算法，在多个数据集上取得显著性能提升。
AI.motivation: 传统FF算法缺乏跨层协调，且特征解耦后语义模糊，限制了表征质量。
AI.method: 提出(1)从粗到细的分层学习策略，引导从低级特征到高级语义的表示；(2)监督对比学习目标，在 goodness 解耦后增强类别判别性对齐。
AI.result: 在CIFAR-10、CIFAR-100和Tiny-ImageNet上分别提升+5.46%、+17.00%和+12.51%，达到FF方法中的SOTA。
AI.conclusion: HCL-FF通过分层对比学习有效解决了FF算法的局限性，在保持生物合理性的同时显著提升了分类精度。

title: HyLaT: Efficient Multi-Agent Communication via Hybrid Latent-Text Protocol
summary: Communication protocol design is a central challenge in large language model-based multi-agent systems. Existing single-channel approaches face an inherent communication trilemma: text-based methods are interpretable but verbose, while latent-space methods are efficient but opaque and limited to unidirectional workflows. Inspired by multi-channel communication theory, we propose HyLaT, a hybrid latent-text communication protocol that transmits elaborate cognitive signals through a latent channel for efficiency, while expressing concise critical signals in natural language to preserve interpretability and precision. We introduce a two-stage training framework combining single-agent hybrid generation learning and multi-agent interactive co-training, enabling agents to generate and interpret hybrid messages across multiple rounds of interaction. Experiments demonstrate that HyLaT reduces communication overhead significantly while maintaining competitive task performance, with strong generalization and robustness across diverse settings.

AI.tldr: HyLaT是一种混合潜在-文本通信协议，通过潜在通道传输认知信号以提高效率，同时用自然语言表达关键信号以保持可解释性，显著降低了多智能体系统的通信开销并保持竞争性任务性能。
AI.motivation: 现有基于大语言模型的多智能体系统中，单通道通信方法面临三元悖论：文本方法可解释但冗长，潜在空间方法高效但不可解释且限于单向工作流，亟需一种兼顾效率与可解释性的通信协议。
AI.method: 提出HyLaT混合潜在-文本通信协议，包含两阶段训练框架：单智能体混合生成学习与多智能体交互协同训练，使智能体能在多轮交互中生成和解析混合消息。
AI.result: HyLaT在显著降低通信开销的同时保持了竞争性任务性能，并在多种设置下展现出强泛化能力和鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: HyLaT有效解决了多智能体通信中的效率与可解释性权衡问题，为大规模多智能体协作系统提供了可行的通信方案。

title: Divide-and-Conquer Inference for Large-Scale Visual Recognition with Multimodal Large Language Models
summary: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have demonstrated strong capabilities across a wide range of vision language tasks. However, when applied to large scale image classification, their performance degrades significantly as the label space expands a phenomenon we define as Performance Collapse in Long Sequence Recognition. Through an information theoretic analysis, we reveal that this collapse stems from a fundamental conflict between the escalating information entropy and the prominent attention dilution and decay within attention mechanisms, which impairs the model's ability to maintain a sufficient signal-to-noise ratio when processing extremely long prompts. To mitigate this, we propose Divide-and-Conquer Inference (DCI), a novel test-time scaling strategy for visual recognition with MLLMs. DCI recursively decomposes complex global classification tasks into multiple simpler, localized subproblems and employs a dynamic pruning mechanism to compress the search space. This method effectively improves the local signal to noise ratio and model accuracy by mitigating the inherent weight dilution issues in long-sequence inference. Moreover, while traditional self-attention incurs a prohibitive quadratic computational complexity, DCI achieves more favorable scaling behavior and substantially accelerates inference in large scale classification scenarios. Extensive experiments on benchmarks such as ImageNet-1K and ImageNet-21K demonstrate that DCI consistently improves classification accuracy. This enables lightweight open-source models to rival or even surpass frontier closed-source giants without any additional training or fine-tuning. As a model-agnostic, plug-and-play paradigm, DCI offers an efficient approach for scaling the inferential precision of MLLMs in large-scale scenarios.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Divide-and-Conquer Inference (DCI)策略，通过递归分解大规模分类任务并动态剪枝，有效缓解了多模态大模型在长序列识别中的性能坍塌问题，无需额外训练即可提升分类精度。
AI.motivation: 多模态大模型在长序列识别中存在性能坍塌问题，即随着标签空间扩大，模型性能显著下降。作者通过信息论分析发现，这源于信息熵增加与注意力机制中注意力稀释和衰减之间的根本冲突，损害了模型在处理超长提示时的信噪比。
AI.method: 提出Divide-and-Conquer Inference (DCI)策略：递归地将复杂的全局分类任务分解为多个简单的局部子问题，并采用动态剪枝机制压缩搜索空间。这是一种无需训练、即插即用的测试时缩放策略。
AI.result: 在ImageNet-1K和ImageNet-21K等基准上，DCI一致提升了分类准确率，使轻量级开源模型媲美甚至超越前沿闭源大模型，并实现了更优的计算缩放行为和更快的推理速度。
AI.conclusion: DCI作为一种模型无关、即插即用的范式，为大规模场景下缩放MLLMs的推理精度提供了一种高效方案。

title: A Multi-Agent LLM Framework for Rating the Quality of Surgical Feedback
summary: Verbal feedback delivered by attending surgeons in the operating room plays a critical formative role in resident trainee skill acquisition. Yet, assessing the quality of trainer feedback and its effectiveness in influencing trainee behavior during live surgery remains a challenge. Prior studies assessed feedback content relying on extensive manual annotation by expert human raters and focused on developing broad taxonomies that overlook the qualitative aspects of feedback delivery such as clarity or urgency. Limited existing automated methods, including keyword analysis and topic modeling, also fail to capture these nuanced aspects. We introduce a two-stage LLM-based framework that discovers interpretable feedback quality criteria grounded in the context of surgical training. Our method uses multi-agent prompting and surgical domain knowledge injection to discover a small set of human interpretable scoring criteria (e.g., Encouraging, Urgent, Clear). These criteria are then used to automatically score live surgical feedback via an LLM-as-a-judge approach. Evaluation on 4.2k trainer feedback instances demonstrates that our AI-discovered criteria outperform prior content-based frameworks in predicting feedback effectiveness, including observed trainee behavioral adjustments and trainer approval. This work advances scalable, human-aligned assessment of communication quality in the operating room and provides a foundation for improving surgical teaching practices.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个两阶段LLM框架，通过多智能体提示和外科领域知识注入，自动发现可解释的反馈质量评分标准（如鼓励性、紧迫性、清晰性），并利用LLM-as-a-judge方法对手术中主治医生的口头反馈进行自动评分。在4200条反馈数据上，该框架优于传统基于内容的方法，能更准确预测反馈对住院医师行为调整的效果。
AI.motivation: 手术中主治医生的口头反馈对住院医师技能习得至关重要，但现有评估方法依赖人工标注或简单的关键词/主题分析，无法捕捉反馈的细微质量特征（如清晰度、紧迫性），缺乏可扩展的自动评估手段。
AI.method: 采用两阶段LLM框架：第一阶段通过多智能体提示和外科领域知识注入，自动发现少量人类可解释的评分标准（如Encouraging, Urgent, Clear）；第二阶段利用LLM-as-a-judge方法，基于这些标准对实时手术反馈进行自动评分。
AI.result: 在4200条反馈实例上，AI发现的标准在预测反馈有效性（包括观察到的住院医师行为调整和主治医生认可度）方面优于传统基于内容的框架。
AI.conclusion: 该方法实现了可扩展且与人类对齐的手术室沟通质量评估，为改进外科教学实践提供了基础。

title: Test-Time Deep Thinking to Explore Implicit Rules
summary: With the continuous advancement of Large Language Models (LLMs), intelligent agents are becoming increasingly vital. However, these agents often fail in environments governed by implicit rules--hidden constraints that cannot be observed directly and must be inferred through interaction. This causes agents to fall into repetitive trial-and-error loops, ultimately leading to task failure. To address this challenge, we propose Test-Time Exploration (TTExplore), a framework where a thinker component analyzes interaction history to infer these implicit rules and guide an actor. Effective exploration in this setting critically depends on the reasoning ability of the thinker. However, evaluating deep reasoning trajectories is inherently unstable and difficult, which poses a major obstacle to effective training. To overcome this issue, we introduce a novel and stable reinforcement learning pipeline. The core idea is to use accurate task-level scores as indirect rewards to bypass the difficulty of evaluating intermediate reasoning, and to retain only a single thinking node per trajectory to alleviate reward sparsity. Using this pipeline, we train a specialized 7B model, Exp-Thinker. Experiments on five text-based embodied tasks show that TTExplore equipped with Exp-Thinker improves baseline agent performance by an average of $14$-$19$ points, demonstrating the effectiveness of explicitly reasoning about implicit rules.

AI.tldr: 提出TTExplore框架，通过训练专门的推理模型Exp-Thinker来推断环境中的隐式规则，使智能体避免试错循环，在五个文本任务上提升14-19个点。
AI.motivation: LLM智能体在面对含隐式规则（无法直接观察、需通过交互推断的隐藏约束）的环境时，容易陷入重复试错循环并导致任务失败。
AI.method: 提出TTExplore框架，包含thinker（分析交互历史推断隐式规则）和actor；采用稳定强化学习流水线，以任务级分数作为间接奖励，每条轨迹仅保留单个思考节点以缓解奖励稀疏性，训练出7B参数的Exp-Thinker模型。
AI.result: 在五个基于文本的具体任务上，配备Exp-Thinker的TTExplore框架比基线智能体性能平均提升14-19个点。
AI.conclusion: 显式推理隐式规则能有效提升智能体在含隐式规则环境中的任务表现。

title: Fishbone: From One 3D Asset to a Million Controllable Edits
summary: Large-scale controllable 3D assets are critical for computer graphics, embodied AI, robotics, and interactive content creation, yet creating diverse 3D assets remains challenging due to the high cost of manual modeling and rigging. Shape deformation offers a natural way to generate variations from existing meshes, but existing data-driven methods often rely on sparse user inputs, while parametric editing frameworks require manually designed control structures and category-specific configurations. Inspired by natural creatures, where a central spine governs global shape and cross-sectional ribs control local variation, we introduce Fishbone, a unified rib-spine representation for general shapes that supports controllable parametric mesh deformation, reduced-space dynamics, and animation. Given an input mesh, Fishbone computes a geodesic scalar field with an adaptive heat method, extracts iso-contours as cross-sectional ribs, constructs a smooth geometry-aware spine through rib centers, and associates surface vertices with nearby rib and spine structures using Gaussian-weighted skinning. The resulting representation enables real-time and predictable deformation: ribs control local profiles such as thickness, orientation, and cross-sectional variation, while the spine controls global bending, twisting, and stretching. The same structure also supports reduced-space simulation and keyframe animation. We further construct Fishbone-136K by augmenting Hunyuan3D with rib-spine structures, and demonstrate applications in controllable 3D generation, deformation-based data augmentation for robot learning, interactive mesh editing, and agentic generation. Experiments demonstrate the effectiveness, efficiency, and versatility of the proposed framework.

AI.tldr: Fishbone提出一种统一的肋骨-脊柱（rib-spine）表示方法，用于通用形状的可控参数化网格变形、降阶动力学和动画，并构建了Fishbone-136K数据集，在可控3D生成、机器人学习数据增强、交互式网格编辑等任务上展示了高效性和通用性。
AI.motivation: 大规模可控3D资产对计算机图形学、具身AI、机器人等领域至关重要，但现有方法要么依赖稀疏用户输入，要么需要手动设计控制结构和类别特定配置，缺乏统一的、高效的变形表示方法。
AI.method: 受自然界生物启发，Fishbone方法：1）通过自适应热方法计算测地标量场；2）提取等值线作为横截面肋骨；3）通过肋骨中心构建几何感知的平滑脊柱；4）使用高斯加权蒙皮将表面顶点与附近肋骨和脊柱关联。肋骨控制局部形变（厚度、方向、横截面变化），脊柱控制全局形变（弯曲、扭曲、拉伸）。
AI.result: 构建了Fishbone-136K数据集，在可控3D生成、基于变形的机器人学习数据增强、交互式网格编辑和智能体生成等任务上进行了验证，实验表明该方法有效、高效且通用。
AI.conclusion: Fishbone提供了一种统一的肋骨-脊柱表示方法，实现了实时且可预测的变形，同时支持降阶仿真和关键帧动画，为通用3D形状的可控编辑和生成提供了新范式。

title: Harmony in Diversity: Multi-domain Contrastive Policy Optimization for Large Reasoning Models
summary: Post-training has significantly enhanced the reasoning capability of Large Reasoning Models (LRMs), especially with Reinforcement Learning (RL) like Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO). However, GRPO-style RL methods in multi-domain settings often fail to achieve consistent improvements across all domains due to inherent interference in policy optimization. Prior studies on multi-domain RL primarily focus on alleviating cross-domain interference, while often neglecting the pivotal role of knowledge sharing, which we argue is the key to transforming cross-domain interactions from harmful competition into beneficial transfer. To address this limitation, we propose Multi-domain Contrastive Policy Optimization (MCPO), which analyzes the structural relationships among rollouts and promotes cross-domain knowledge sharing and in-domain knowledge consolidation in a contrastive manner. Specifically, for a given prompt, MCPO identifies transferable reasoning trajectories from other domains as positive examples, while treating incorrect rollouts as negative ones. It then encourages consistent representations for positive pairs and pushes negative pairs apart, thereby facilitating knowledge transfer and reducing interference. Moreover, MCPO aligns intra-domain correct rollouts to build a consolidated representation space. In this way, MCPO contrastively learns a harmonious representation space that can accommodate diverse multi-domain knowledge. Empirical results show that MCPO improves the reasoning capabilities of LRMs across multiple domains and even outperforms single-domain training in some cases. Code is available at https://github.com/Maricalce/MCPO.

AI.tldr: 本文提出多领域对比策略优化（MCPO），通过对比学习促进跨领域知识共享、减少干扰，提升大型推理模型在多领域的推理能力，甚至在某些场景下超越单领域训练。
AI.motivation: 现有GRPO-style RL在多领域训练中存在跨领域干扰问题，而以往研究多聚焦于减轻干扰，忽略了知识共享的关键作用。作者认为知识共享能将跨领域交互从有害竞争转化为有益迁移。
AI.method: MCPO分析rollout结构关系，将其他领域可迁移的推理轨迹作为正例、错误rollout作为负例，通过对比学习拉近正例表示、推开负例表示，实现跨领域知识共享与域内知识整合。
AI.result: 实验表明MCPO能提升LRMs在多领域的推理能力，部分情况下甚至优于单领域训练。
AI.conclusion: 通过对比学习协调多领域知识表示空间，MCPO有效解决了多领域RL中的干扰与知识共享权衡问题，为多领域推理模型训练提供了新范式。

title: Geo-Expert: Towards Expert-Level Geological Reasoning via Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning
