Together, our evaluation protocol, transfer-aware metrics, and method expose hidden brittleness in current W2S reward modeling and provide a practical path toward more robust preference transfer.

AI.tldr: 本文研究弱到强（W2S）偏好学习在零样本分布偏移下的表现，发现弱监督微调会导致强模型的特征表示向源域偏移，从而影响跨数据集迁移。为此提出表示锚定（Anchor）正则化方法，有效改善分布外迁移性能。
AI.motivation: 现有W2S评估多在匹配的训练-测试分布下进行，未充分研究分布偏移场景下的偏好学习鲁棒性问题。
AI.method: 提出表示锚定（Representation Anchoring）正则化方法，在微调过程中约束强模型表示空间过度偏离预训练状态，同时保留任务相关适应性。
AI.result: Anchor方法在多个偏好领域、数据集和模型族上持续改善分布外迁移性能，同时保持有竞争力的分布内表现。
AI.conclusion: 现有W2S奖励建模存在隐藏的脆弱性，Anchor提供了一种实用的路径实现更鲁棒的偏好迁移。

title: Beyond the Frontier: Stochastic Backtracking for Efficient Test-Time Scaling
summary: Test-time scaling improves language model reasoning by spending additional compute to explore multiple solution trajectories. The key challenge is to maximize accuracy while minimizing the total number of generated tokens during reasoning. Recent PRM-guided methods score intermediate prefixes to steer this search, but most are frontier-only: they keep only the current active prefixes and irreversibly prune or resample away the rest using noisy PRM scores. This can cause premature commitment, diversity collapse, and the loss of prefixes that still admit correct continuations. We introduce stochastic backtracking over a persistent pool of historical prefixes, allowing test-time compute to revisit previously generated states instead of only expanding the current frontier. To make this efficient, we propose two complementary mechanisms. Subpool Selection strengthens greedy PRM-guided search by applying Top-N selection within random subpools, giving historical prefixes a chance to bypass over-scored frontier candidates. Power Backtrack Sequential Monte Carlo extends SMC-style resampling to the persistent pool using powered PRM scores and mixture-corrected weights. Across mathematical reasoning benchmarks and model scales, our methods consistently achieve higher accuracy per token count, and the same level of accuracy using only a fraction of the token count in comparison to strong PRM-guided baselines, demonstrating that persistent-pool stochastic backtracking provides a simple and effective way to improve the accuracy-token trade-off in test-time scaling.

AI.tldr: 本文提出基于持久化历史前缀池的随机回溯方法，通过子池选择与功率回溯序列蒙特卡洛两种机制，在测试时扩展推理中实现更优的准确率-生成token数权衡。
AI.motivation: 现有PRM引导的测试时扩展方法仅保留当前活跃前缀，基于噪声PRM分数进行不可逆剪枝或重采样，导致过早承诺、多样性崩溃以及丢失可能包含正确延续的前缀。
AI.method: 1) 维护持久化历史前缀池，允许回溯到之前生成的状态；2) 子池选择：在随机子池内进行Top-N选择，让历史前缀有机会绕过高分但错误的前沿候选；3) 功率回溯序列蒙特卡洛：使用带功率的PRM分数和混合校正权重，将SMC风格重采样扩展到持久化池。
AI.result: 在数学推理基准和多种模型规模上，所提方法在相同准确率下使用更少的token数，或在相同token预算下实现更高的准确率，一致优于强PRM引导基线。
AI.conclusion: 持久化池随机回溯是提升测试时扩展中准确率- token数权衡的简单有效方法。

title: Cross-Domain Generalization Limits of Vision Foundation Models in Facial Deepfake Detection
summary: The rapid evolution of generative models has enabled the creation of hyper-realistic facial deepfakes, exposing a critical vulnerability in modern digital forensics: the inability of detectors to generalize to unseen manipulation techniques. Traditional networks suffer from representation collapse, overfitting to localized artifact fingerprints of specific training generators. This work investigates whether modern Vision Foundation Models can serve as generalizable, out-of-the-box feature extractors capable of tracking forensic anomalies across entirely unseen generative manifolds. We conduct a systematic cross-domain evaluation comparing three foundational learning paradigms: fully supervised macro-semantic features (RoPE-ViT), pure self-supervised geometric features (DINOv3), and multi-teacher agglomerative representations (NVIDIA C-RADIOv4-H). By deploying frozen backbones subjected to downstream linear probing, we map the performance limitations of these architectures on the challenging DF40 benchmark. Our empirical findings expose the intrinsic trade-offs between pre-training paradigms and parameter scale, proving that while foundation models retain high discriminative capabilities for entire face synthesis, localized face editing techniques expose fundamental boundaries in linear probe evaluation structures. Source code and model weights are available in http://github.com/mribrahim/deepfake

AI.tldr: 本文研究了视觉基础模型作为通用深度伪造检测器的可行性，系统比较了三种预训练范式（监督学习、自监督学习、多教师聚合）在DF40基准上的表现，发现基础模型在检测完整人脸合成方面表现良好，但在局部人脸编辑检测中存在局限性。
AI.motivation: 现有深度伪造检测器难以泛化到未见过的生成技术，存在表征坍塌和过拟合问题，亟需探索更通用的特征提取方法。
AI.method: 采用冻结骨干网络+线性探测的方式，系统比较三种视觉基础模型范式（RoPE-ViT、DINOv3、C-RADIOv4-H），在DF40基准上进行跨域评估。
AI.result: 基础模型在完整人脸合成检测上保持高判别能力，但在局部人脸编辑检测中表现有限，揭示了预训练范式与参数规模之间的内在权衡。
AI.conclusion: 视觉基础模型可作为通用深度伪造检测的有效特征提取器，但对局部编辑技术的检测仍存在边界，线性探测评估结构存在固有局限。

title: Reinforcement Learning from Denoising Feedback
summary: Policy loss estimation remains a fundamental and long-standing challenge in reinforcement learning (RL) for diffusion language models (dLLMs). We introduce Reinforcement Learning from Denoising Feedback (RLDF), a novel training paradigm that leverages feedback obtained from rollout and training processes to facilitate accurate and efficient policy loss estimation. To balance the trade-off between computational efficiency and estimation effectiveness, RLDF optimizes the model toward the clipped clean state $\hat{x}_0$ from intermediate noisy states $x_t$, combined with weighted timestep sampling over $t$. Extensive experiments demonstrate that RLDF achieves consistent and substantial improvements in both performance and generalizability across two representative dLLM architectures, LLaDA and Dream, on multiple reasoning benchmarks. Our work lays a principled foundation for scalable reinforcement learning in diffusion language models. We build Drift, a training framework for dLLMs, available at https://github.com/ant-research/Drift.

AI.tldr: 本文提出RLDF（基于去噪反馈的强化学习），一种针对扩散语言模型（dLLMs）的新型训练范式，通过利用展开和训练过程中的反馈信号，实现准确高效的策略损失估计。RLDF优化模型从中间噪声状态向裁剪后的干净状态学习，结合加权时间步采样，在多个推理基准上取得了显著且一致的性能提升。
AI.motivation: 扩散语言模型（dLLMs）中的策略损失估计一直是一个长期存在的基础性挑战，现有的方法在计算效率和估计有效性之间存在难以平衡的问题。
AI.method: 提出RLDF范式，利用从展开（rollout）和训练过程中获得的去噪反馈；通过优化模型从中间噪声状态$x_t$向裁剪后的干净状态$\hat{x}_0$学习；结合加权时间步采样来平衡计算效率与估计效果。
AI.result: 在LLaDA和Dream两种代表性dLLM架构上，多个推理基准测试中均取得了一致且显著的性能提升和泛化能力改进。
AI.conclusion: RLDF为扩散语言模型的可扩展强化学习奠定了原则性基础，并开源了Drift训练框架。

title: Representation Without Control: Testing the Realization Effect in Language Models
summary: Large language models are increasingly used as behavioral simulators, but it remains unclear when their outputs reflect human-like cognitive mechanisms rather than prompt-sensitive surface patterns. We study this question through the realization effect, a well-characterized finding in behavioral economics in which risk-taking differs systematically after paper versus realized gains and losses. We evaluate LLM behavior at three levels: prompt-only behavioral sensitivity, linear readout of internal representations, and causal control via activation steering. Prompt-only results show systematic condition sensitivity, but the directional pattern does not reproduce human realization-effect predictions. Gemma's residual stream contains a linearly decodable realization-status signal at layer 18 that generalizes to held-out prompts. Steering along this direction does not, however, reliably shift downstream risk choices, a null result that holds across positive scales and in a negative sign-symmetry run. Behavioral sensitivity, latent readout, and causal control are three distinct properties that do not automatically co-occur, and successful latent readout is insufficient evidence that a model behaviorally relies on a representation during downstream decision-making.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过行为经济学中的"实现效应"范式，系统评估了LLM在行为敏感性、潜在表征解码和因果控制三个层面的表现，发现这三个属性并不自动共存，成功的潜在表征解码不足以证明模型在决策中实际依赖该表征。
AI.motivation: 探究LLM的输出反映的是类似人类的认知机制，还是仅仅对提示敏感的表面模式。
AI.method: 通过实现效应实验，从三个层面评估LLM：仅提示的行为敏感性、内部表示的线性解码、以及通过激活引导的因果控制。
AI.result: 提示结果显示条件敏感性，但方向模式不符合人类实现效应预测；Gemma残差流在18层存在可线性解码的实现状态信号且能泛化；但沿该方向引导无法可靠改变下游风险选择，正负两个方向均为零结果。
AI.conclusion: 行为敏感性、潜在表征解码和因果控制是三个不同且不会自动共存的属性，仅凭潜在表征解码成功不足以证明模型在决策中实际依赖该表征。

title: MinerU-Popo: Universal Post-Processing Model for Structured Document Parsing
summary:
VLM-based OCR models have become the de facto choice for document parsing, as they can accurately extract page-level elements (e.g., paragraphs within individual pages) together with their bounding boxes and textual content. However, downstream applications such as RAG require coherent document-level information, whereas these models often break cross-page continuity and fail to recover disrupted structures, such as paragraphs and tables truncated by page boundaries. Such relationships are not confined to a single page; instead, they require joint analysis of titles, paragraphs, tables, and images spanning multiple pages. A natural solution is therefore to reuse existing OCR outputs and reconstruct document-level logical structures through post-processing.
  To this end, we propose MinerU-Popo, a lightweight and universal framework for POst-Processing OCR outputs, which converts page-level results from diverse parsers into coherent document-level structures. MinerU-Popo decomposes the problem into four focused subtasks: text truncation recovery, table truncation recovery, title hierarchy reconstruction, and image-text association. To address these effectively, we build a task-oriented data engine with task-specific input filtering, and use the generated data (30K) to fine-tune a lightweight post-processing model (Qwen3-VL-4B). To support long documents, we introduce dynamic chunking with overlap-based synchronization, which aligns chunk-level outputs from the fine-tuned model and preserves global consistency. Finally, we assemble the aligned outputs into a tree-structured document representation, further enriched with node chunking and summaries for downstream retrieval and analysis. Empirical results show MinerU-Popo improves title-hierarchy TEDS by at least 20% across all five tested OCR models, improves RAG accuracy and reduces per-query latency.

AI.tldr: 本文提出MinerU-Popo，一个轻量级通用后处理框架，将OCR输出的页面级结果转换为连贯的文档级结构，通过四个子任务（文本截断恢复、表格截断恢复、标题层级重建、图文关联）和动态分块策略，显著提升RAG准确率并降低延迟。
AI.motivation: 现有VLM-based OCR模型能准确提取页面级元素，但下游应用（如RAG）需要文档级连贯信息，而这些模型会破坏跨页连续性，导致段落、表格等结构被页面边界截断，因此需要一种后处理方法将OCR输出重构为文档级逻辑结构。
AI.method: 将问题分解为四个子任务（文本截断恢复、表格截断恢复、标题层级重建、图文关联）；构建任务导向的数据引擎生成3万条训练数据；用Qwen3-VL-4B微调轻量级后处理模型；引入动态分块与重叠同步机制处理长文档，对齐分块级输出并保持全局一致性；最后组装为树形文档结构，辅以节点分块和摘要。
AI.result: 在五种OCR模型上，标题层级TEDS提升至少20%；提高了RAG准确率并降低了每次查询的延迟。
AI.conclusion: MinerU-Popo作为一个轻量级通用后处理框架，能有效将任意OCR解析器的页面级输出重构为连贯的文档级结构，显著提升下游RAG任务性能，且具有跨模型泛化能力。

title: SimuWoB: Simulating Real-World Mobile Apps for Fast and Faithful GUI Agent Benchmarking
summary: Mobile GUI agents powered by large language models have progressed rapidly, creating urgent needs for realistic and comprehensive evaluation. Existing benchmarks prioritize reproducibility but are often limited to open-source apps or file-operation tasks for the difficulty of constructing rewards on real applications, leaving a gap between benchmark settings and real-world usage. Moreover, most benchmarks focus on basic grounding and navigation, with limited coverage of complex, long-horizon interactions. To address these limitations, we introduce SimuWoB, a fully synthetic benchmark for mobile GUI agents with 120 challenging tasks spanning diverse types and difficulty levels. We build a robust virtual environment generation framework that synthesizes high-fidelity tasks and environments, and automatically provides valid rewards for each task. Each environment is deployed as a backend-free webpage accessible via URL, enabling efficient and reproducible evaluation. We conduct comprehensive experiments on several state-of-the-art mobile GUI agents. The average success rate is only 27.92%, dropping to 17.82% on long-horizon tasks, which reveals substantial weaknesses in current agents under complex scenarios. Evaluation result comparison with real-world sample tasks demonstrate that agent assessments based on our synthetic environment generalize well. We further provide diagnostic insights across key capability dimensions and discuss implications for future mobile GUI agent development.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SimuWoB，一个全合成的移动GUI智能体基准测试，包含120个具有挑战性的任务。该基准通过虚拟环境生成框架自动创建高保真任务并提供有效奖励，实验表明当前最优智能体平均成功率仅27.92%，在长序列任务上降至17.82%，揭示了现有智能体在复杂场景下的重大不足。
AI.motivation: 现有移动GUI智能体基准测试存在两个主要局限：(1) 大多基于开源应用或文件操作任务，难以在真实应用上构建奖励，导致基准设置与真实使用之间存在差距；(2) 大多数基准侧重于基本的地面和导航能力，对复杂、长序列交互的覆盖有限。
AI.method: 构建了一个鲁棒的虚拟环境生成框架，可合成高保真任务和环境，并自动为每个任务提供有效奖励。每个环境部署为无需后端的网页，可通过URL访问，实现高效且可复现的评估。
AI.result: 对多个最先进的移动GUI智能体进行全面实验，平均成功率仅27.92%，长序列任务上降至17.82%。与真实样本任务的评估结果比较表明，基于合成环境的智能体评估具有良好的泛化性。
AI.conclusion: 当前移动GUI智能体在复杂场景下存在显著弱点，SimuWoB为未来移动GUI智能体的发展提供了诊断性洞察和重要启示。

title: A Two-Phase Stability Study of LLM Judges and Bar Council Examiners on Thai Bar-Exam Free-Form Essays
summary: Free-form legal essay evaluation in NLP treats expert inter-rater stability as a single ceiling number, and treats LLM-judge agreement with that ceiling as evidence of judge stability. We test both assumptions on the Thai bar examination through an identical-inputs protocol: three Bar Council-trained examiners (A, B, C) and a 26-LLM judge panel score the same 15 cross-graded answers from the same four inputs (question, official Bar Council grading regulation, gold answer, candidate answer). The headline finding is asymmetric. On 10 of 15 cells where the rubric prescribes both axes, all 29 raters converge in a tight band: panel agreement is universal. On the remaining 5 cells where the rubric does not prescribe how to grade a correct final answer that omits a decisive statutory citation, the human panel splits between two coherent readings (B/C majority at the upper rubric band, score $6$--$8$; A minority at the lower band, score $1$--$2$). The LLM judge population does not split symmetrically: 22 of 26 LLMs score in or near B/C's contested band, 3 sit in the regulation-silent middle gap, and only 1 (GPT-5.4 Nano) approaches A's band without consistently scoring within it. \emph{Zero LLMs in our 26-judge panel reproduce the minority human reading on the contested cells.} The B/C-direction cluster spans every model size, vendor, and price tier we tested. An instrumented three-LLM anchor sub-panel (Claude 4.6 Opus, Gemini 3.1 Pro, GPT-5.4 Pro) carries determinism probes, input ablations, and bootstrap CIs, and reaches anchor panel $α= 0.77$ on the 15 cells against human-panel $α= 0.36$. The high LLM-panel $α$ reflects systematic convergence on the majority reading rather than balanced reproduction of both readings; a benchmark that selects its LLM judge by maximising agreement with a human reference panel will inherit this asymmetry by construction.

AI.tldr: 本文通过泰国律师考试的真实评级实验，发现人类评分员在无明确评分标准的试题上存在显著分歧（少数派与多数派阅读差异达6分），而26个LLM评委全部偏向多数派解读，没有模型复制少数派人类评分，导致LLM间信度高但偏差大。
AI.motivation: 现有法律文本评估研究将专家间评分稳定性视为单一天花板值，并将LLM评审与该天花板的一致性视为判断稳定性的证据。然而，这种假设忽略了一个关键问题：当专家间本身存在系统性分歧时，LLM是否只是选择性地趋同于多数派解读？
AI.method: 在泰国律师考试中采用相同输入协议：3位律师委员会培训的评审员（A、B、C）和26个LLM评审面板对同一组15份交叉评分的答卷进行评分（基于相同的四个输入：问题、官方评分规定、标准答案、考生答案）。LLM评审面板涵盖不同规模、供应商和价格层级。另设一个锚定子面板（3个LLM）进行确定性探测、输入消融和Bootstrap置信区间分析。
AI.result: 在15个评分维度中，10个维度上所有29位评分者高度一致；但在5个评分标准未明确规定的维度上，人类评审员分裂为两个明显的阵营（B/C多数派评分6-8，A少数派评分1-2）。26个LLM中，22个靠近B/C的多数派区间，3个落在中间空白区，仅1个（GPT-5.4 Nano）接近但未完全进入A的区间——没有任何LLM复现少数派人类阅读。LLM锚定面板的α=0.77，远高于人类面板的α=0.36，但高α反映的是系统性趋同于多数派解读。
AI.conclusion: LLM评审面板的高一致性并非源于对专家判断的平衡复制，而是系统性偏向多数派解读。通过最大化与人类参考面板的一致性来选择LLM评审的基准方法，会天然继承这种不对称性，从而掩盖少数派但合理的人类判断。

title: SpecAlign: A Semantic Alignment Framework for SystemVerilog Assertion Generation
summary: Existing Large Language Model (LLM) approaches to SystemVerilog Assertion (SVA) generation primarily focus on syntactic validity and formal verification outcomes, while semantic alignment between generated assertions and natural language specifications remains difficult to quantify. As a result, hallucinated or misaligned SVAs can reduce confidence and increase debugging efforts in the absence of golden RTL. This paper presents SpecAlign, a framework for semantic evaluation and refinement of LLM-generated SVAs. SpecAlign introduces two iterative alignment loops that assess both natural language properties and SVAs against the design specification using entailment-based classification. We improve alignment decisions by generating multiple reasoning paths using chain-of-thought prompting and aggregating them via a self-consistency voting mechanism. Misaligned assertions are analyzed to generate actionable feedback for refinement. We further define a quantitative alignment score to measure semantic consistency across iterations. Experimental results demonstrate that SpecAlign effectively detects semantic inconsistencies and improves assertion alignment without relying on golden RTL, providing a scalable complement to traditional formal verification evaluation metrics.

AI.tldr: 提出SpecAlign框架，通过蕴含分类和自一致性投票机制，无需黄金RTL即可评估和优化LLM生成的SystemVerilog断言与自然语言规范之间的语义对齐。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM生成SVA的方法主要关注语法有效性和形式验证结果，而生成的断言与自然语言规范之间的语义对齐难以量化，导致幻觉或错配的断言降低置信度并增加调试工作。
AI.method: 引入两个迭代对齐循环，使用蕴含分类评估自然语言属性和SVA；通过思维链提示生成多条推理路径，并利用自一致性投票机制聚合结果；对未对齐断言进行分析生成可操作的反馈。
AI.result: 实验表明SpecAlign能有效检测语义不一致性，并在无需黄金RTL的情况下改善断言对齐效果。
AI.conclusion: SpecAlign为传统形式验证评估指标提供了可扩展的补充方案。

title: ClueAegis: Heuristic-to-Reasoning Cognitive-skill Learning for Unified Evidence-based Synthetic Image Detection
summary: The rapid advancement of generative models has made synthetic images increasingly realistic, challenging reliable detection. Existing methods are often limited to end-to-end classification or monolithic reasoning, and thus fail to model structured forensic reasoning and heterogeneous visual evidence. We revisit synthetic image detection from a cognitive perspective and propose a \textit{Heuristic-to-Reasoning} cognitive skill learning framework for evidence-based forensic analysis. Given an input image, our framework first extracts heuristic perceptual clues, selects the optimal forensic skill, and then performs skill-conditioned reasoning for evidence extraction and decision making. To support this paradigm, we introduce \textbf{ClueAegis-Bench}, which decomposes synthetic image detection into explicitly annotated forensic cognitive skills for structured evaluation beyond binary classification. Based on this benchmark, we propose \textbf{ClueAegis} (\underline{C}ognitive-skill \underline{L}earning for \underline{U}nified \underline{E}vidence-based Synthetic Image Detection), a two-stage agentic framework that conducts heuristic skill selection followed by evidence-guided reasoning through skill-conditioned toolchains. This design reformulates synthetic image detection as a configurable multi-skill reasoning process that bridges perception, skill selection, and forensic reasoning. Extensive experiments show that ClueAegis achieves state-of-the-art performance while improving cross-domain generalization and robustness. It also provides transparent reasoning trajectories and structured forensic evidence, offering a more explainable alternative to conventional end-to-end detectors.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种名为ClueAegis的启发式到推理的认知技能学习框架，用于可解释的合成图像检测，并配套构建了ClueAegis-Bench基准数据集，通过多技能推理实现超越二分类的结构化取证分析，在性能、泛化性和可解释性上均达到最先进水平。
AI.motivation: 现有合成图像检测方法局限于端到端分类或单一推理，缺乏结构化的取证推理能力和对异质视觉证据的建模能力，难以应对日益逼真的生成式伪造图像。
AI.method: 提出Heuristic-to-Reasoning认知技能学习框架：首先提取启发式感知线索，选择最优取证技能，然后基于技能条件进行推理（证据提取与决策）。具体实现为ClueAegis两阶段智能体框架，包含启发式技能选择和证据引导推理两个阶段，通过技能条件工具链完成结构化推理。
AI.result: ClueAegis在多个基准上达到最先进性能，显著提升了跨领域泛化能力和鲁棒性，同时提供了透明的推理轨迹和结构化的取证证据。
AI.conclusion: 将合成图像检测重新定义为可配置的多技能推理过程，桥接了感知、技能选择和取证推理，相比传统端到端检测器提供了更具可解释性的替代方案。

title: AutoSG: LLM-Driven Solver Generation Solely from Task Prompts for Expensive Optimization
summary: Expensive optimization tasks are ubiquitous in real-world applications, demanding highly specialized solvers. While LLM-driven automated solver generation shows promise, current paradigms face three critical issues when tackling expensive optimization: factual hallucinations due to deficient domain knowledge, the frequent dismantling of previously established locally optimal structures during refinement, and the prohibitive evaluation costs alongside restricted generalization caused by executing on training instances. To address these issues, we introduce AutoSG, a fully automated workflow directly translating natural language prompts into executable customized solvers. AutoSG features three core innovations: a retrieval-augmented solver generation module strictly grounding code in verified literature; a one-step self-refinement operator introducing task-specific improvements while preserving critical structural components; and an instance-free Elo-based LLM-as-a-Judge evaluation mechanism rapidly establishing global rankings. Extensive evaluations across diverse expensive optimization tasks confirm AutoSG significantly outperforms human-designed state-of-the-art frameworks and existing LLM-generated solvers.

AI.tldr: 提出AutoSG框架，通过检索增强生成、单步自优化和无实例评估机制，解决LLM在昂贵优化任务中的幻觉、结构破坏和评估成本问题，显著优于人工及现有LLM生成的求解器。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM驱动的自动化求解器生成在应对昂贵优化任务时存在三个关键问题：领域知识不足导致的事实幻觉、优化过程中破坏已建立的局部最优结构、以及训练实例上执行带来的高昂评估成本和有限的泛化能力。
AI.method: AutoSG包含三个核心创新：1）检索增强的求解器生成模块，将代码严格基于经过验证的文献；2）单步自优化算子，在引入任务特定改进的同时保留关键结构组件；3）基于Elo的LLM-as-a-Judge无实例评估机制，快速建立全局排名。
AI.result: 在多种昂贵优化任务上的广泛评估证实，AutoSG显著优于人工设计的最先进框架和现有LLM生成的求解器。
AI.conclusion: AutoSG是一种全自动工作流，能够将自然语言提示直接转化为可执行的定制求解器，有效解决了当前范式在昂贵优化中的核心瓶颈。

title: DarkForest: Less Talk, Higher Accuracy for Multi-Agent LLMs
summary: Multi-agent LLM systems improve reasoning by combining outputs from multiple agents, but interaction-heavy methods can introduce error propagation and high communication overhead. When agents exchange raw responses or reasoning traces, incorrect intermediate reasoning may be adopted and amplified, leading to confident but wrong consensus; multi-round communication also increases token consumption, latency, and inference cost. In this paper, we propose a controlled-communication coordination framework named DarkForest. DarkForest first keeps agents independent, so each agent produces an answer without seeing the others' outputs. It then parses the raw responses into structured candidate records, groups semantically equivalent candidates into clusters, and estimates a calibrated belief distribution over these clusters using agent reliability, confidence, parse quality, support-pattern reliability, and independence corrections. A coordinator receives only policy-permitted evidence from this belief state with controlled communication. Experiments on six reasoning benchmarks show that DarkForest achieves leading overall quality, improves the strongest baseline by up to 30.7\% on benchmark metrics, and reduces token consumption by up to $6.5\times$ compared with communication-heavy baselines.

AI.tldr: 提出DarkForest框架，通过结构化解析、语义聚类和校准信念分布实现多智能体LLM系统的受控通信协调，在保持高质量推理的同时大幅降低通信开销和错误传播。
AI.motivation: 现有交互密集型多智能体LLM方法存在错误传播（智能体间传递错误中间推理）和高通信开销（多轮对话消耗大量token、增加延迟和推理成本）两大问题。
AI.method: DarkForest框架包含：(1) 独立推理阶段，各智能体独立产生答案；(2) 结构化解析与语义聚类；(3) 基于智能体可靠性、置信度、解析质量等多因素校准信念分布；(4) 协调器仅接收策略允许的受控通信证据。
AI.result: 在六个推理基准上达到领先整体质量，在基准指标上比最强基线提升最多30.7%，相比高通信基线减少最多6.5倍token消耗。
AI.conclusion: DarkForest通过受控通信协调策略，有效平衡了多智能体系统的推理质量与通信效率，证明减少不必要交互可以同时提升准确率和降低计算成本。

title: Learning from Semantic Dictionaries: Discriminative Codebook Contrastive Learning for Unified Visual Representation and Generation
summary: Discriminative and generative vision models excel in their respective domains but remain semantically misaligned, hindering progress toward unified visual learning. We introduce LEASE (LEArning from SEmantic Dictionaries), a self-supervised framework that bridges this gap using a paired generative-discriminative codebook design. LEASE operates entirely in a discrete token space produced through a one-time precomputation step, enabling efficient training without data augmentations, teacher models, or online tokenizers. LEASE integrates two complementary objectives: a masked token reconstruction loss that captures fine-grained generative detail, and a codebook contrast loss that aligns encoder features with discriminative semantics via adaptive centroid weighting. This dual supervision yields a unified latent space that supports both high-quality generation and strong representation learning. On ImageNet-1K, LEASE achieves state-of-the-art unified performance, outperforming prior VQGAN-based methods such as MAGE and Sorcen across linear probing (up to +1.7%), unconditional generation (-1.26 FID and +10.19 IS w.r.t MAGE), few-shot learning (+0.56% on average against Sorcen), transfer (+0.75% average improvement against MAGE and Sorcen), and robustness benchmarks (+5.86% and +4.25% average improvement against MAGE and Sorcen, respectively). It also competes favorably with domain-specialized contrastive and generative models while surpassing previous MIM methods. The unsupervised LEASE model can also be extended to conditional generation by building upon its learned representations, proving competitive with specialized baselines. Overall, LEASE provides an efficient and effective step toward general-purpose vision models that jointly understand and generate visual content.

AI.tldr: LEASE是一个自监督框架，通过配对生成-判别式码本设计，在离散token空间中统一视觉理解与生成任务，在ImageNet-1K上达到了SOTA性能。
AI.motivation: 现有判别式和生成式视觉模型在各领域表现优异，但语义上不一致，阻碍了统一视觉学习的发展。研究旨在弥合这一差距，构建通用视觉模型。
AI.method: 提出LEASE框架，包含配对生成-判别式码本设计，在预计算的离散token空间中，通过掩码token重建损失（捕捉细粒度生成细节）和码本对比损失（通过自适应质心加权对齐判别语义）进行双目标联合训练。
AI.result: 在ImageNet-1K上，线性探测提升+1.7%，无条件生成FID降低1.26、IS提升10.19，少样本学习平均提升+0.56%，迁移平均提升+0.75%，鲁棒性平均提升+5.86%和+4.25%，均优于MAGE和Sorcen等先前方法。
AI.conclusion: LEASE提供了一种高效且有效的统一视觉模型方案，能够同时理解和生成视觉内容，向通用视觉模型迈出了重要一步。

title: Llamion Technical Report
summary: We release Llamion, a family of 14B-parameter open-weight language models obtained by transforming Orion-14B into the standardized Llama-family architecture. The transformation is performed by Efficient Knowledge Preservation for Transformation (KEPT), a recipe that combines (i) Normal Parameter Mapping (NPM) for unchanged modules, (ii) Optimized Parameter Mapping (OPM), a training-free LayerNorm-to-RMSNorm initialization we prove optimal under the near-zero-mean activation regime induced by weight decay, and (iii) Cross-architecture Knowledge Distillation (XKD), an equal-size frozen-teacher distillation that aligns the converted model's outputs with the source model's on any reasonable input distribution. Llamion recovers Orion's behaviour on H6, MT-Bench, and KoMMLU with only ~123M tokens on a single A100 in four days; Llamion-Base reaches 66.87% on KoMMLU, exceeding the next-best entry of the Open Ko LLM Leaderboard by >7.0 absolute points at submission time. Capabilities entirely absent from the transfer corpus (Python programming and 200K-token context handling) survive the architectural transition intact. We release three checkpoints (Base, Chat, LongChat) that load with trust_remote_code=False in the Hugging Face Transformers library.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了Llamion，一个通过KEPT方法将Orion-14B转换为Llama架构的14B参数语言模型家族，仅用约1.23亿token和单卡A100四天训练，便在韩语MMLU等基准上取得领先性能。
AI.motivation: 将已有高性能模型（Orion-14B）转换到更标准、兼容性更强的Llama架构，以提升模型的可迁移性、生态兼容性和易用性，同时保留原有能力。
AI.method: 提出KEPT方法，包含三个组件：NPM（直接复制未变模块参数）、OPM（无需训练的LayerNorm到RMSNorm最优映射）、XKD（等规模冻结教师的知识蒸馏）。
AI.result: Llamion在H6、MT-Bench和KoMMLU上恢复Orion性能；Base版KoMMLU达66.87%，超当时公开排行榜第二名7+绝对百分点；编程和长上下文能力完整保留。
AI.conclusion: 通过KEPT方法可高效地将非标准架构模型转化为标准Llama架构，训练成本低且能力无损甚至超越，验证了架构转换路线的可行性。

title: Boosting Inference with Guided Reasoning: Stochastic Exploration for Recursive Models
comment: Presented at the proceedings of the ICML 2026 Workshop on Structured Probabilistic Inference & Generative Modeling (SPIGM)}, Seoul, South Korea. 2026
summary: Recent work on recursive architectures has shown that tiny neural networks can be surprisingly powerful on structured reasoning tasks. The trick is to model reasoning trajectories with a latent dynamical system. We argue that the inference-time behaviour of these architectures is best understood as approximate inference over latent reasoning trajectories, with deterministic recursion as the one-particle, zero-noise limit. We make this view operational through guided stochastic exploration: stochastic perturbations of the reasoning dynamics propose neighbouring trajectories, and the model's existing early-stopping head reweights them online. The framework yields three label-free diagnostics: local stability, guide alignment, and cloud-token entropy. These predict, from inference traces alone, whether the procedure will help and which of its outputs to trust. On Sudoku-Extreme it lifts exact-solve accuracy from $85.9\%$ to $98.0\%$ without retraining; on Maze-Hard the diagnostics flag a misaligned guide, as validation performance later confirms. The same machinery thus characterises both when recursive reasoning has room to improve at the trajectory level and when the model's internal guide can recover it.

AI.tldr: 本文提出将递归架构的推理行为理解为隐式推理轨迹上的近似推断，并通过引导式随机探索提升性能，无需重新训练即可在Sudoku-Extreme上将准确率从85.9%提升至98.0%，同时提出三种无标签诊断指标。
AI.motivation: 现有递归架构在结构化推理任务上表现优异，但其推理轨迹的随机性与确定性行为之间的关系尚未被清晰建模，缺乏有效的诊断工具来预测推理改进的潜力。
AI.method: 将确定性递归视为单粒子、零噪声极限下的近似推断；通过随机扰动生成邻近轨迹，并利用模型自有的早停头在线重加权；提出三种无标签诊断指标：局部稳定性、引导对齐度和云令牌熵。
AI.result: 在Sudoku-Extreme上，精确求解准确率从85.9%提升至98.0%；在Maze-Hard上，诊断指标成功检测到引导对齐问题，与后续验证结果一致。
AI.conclusion: 该框架既能表征递归推理何时有改进空间，也能判断模型内部引导机制能否恢复推理性能，为无需重训的推理增强提供了理论依据和实用工具。

title: Stop Denoising Your Blurs
comment: Accepted at IEEE International Conference on Image Processing (ICIP) 2026. 7 pages, 3 figures
summary: In recent times, diffusion models have achieved remarkable performance in image restoration tasks. Their core mechanism relies on the restricted presumption of degradation prior to the additive noise operation. However, the blur model, one of the most widely studied degradation formulations, violates this assumption, as it is inherently based on convolution rather than addition. In this paper, we introduce ConvDiff, a novel diffusion based framework that substitutes the additive operation with convolution for the task of image deblurring. In the forward process, we construct a meaningful trajectory from the clean image to its blurred counterpart by exploiting the frequency domain characteristics of convolution, rather than progressively corrupting the image with additive noise. While the current work instantiates this framework for Gaussian blur, where frequency-domain decomposition yields closed-form and physically valid intermediate states, the underlying principle of constructing degradation trajectories from the blur operator extends naturally to other blur families. This formulation bridges the gap between the mathematical principles of blurring and the iterative design of diffusion-based restoration algorithms, enabling more physically grounded and effective image restoration models.

AI.tldr: ConvDiff是一种基于卷积替代加法的扩散模型框架，用于图像去模糊任务，通过频域特性构建从清晰图像到模糊图像的前向轨迹，实现更物理合理的图像恢复。
AI.motivation: 现有的扩散模型在图像恢复任务中依赖于加性噪声假设，但模糊模型本质上是卷积操作而非加法，这与扩散模型的核心机制存在矛盾，因此需要一种更符合模糊物理原理的方法。
AI.method: 提出ConvDiff框架，在前向过程中利用卷积的频域特性，构建从清晰图像到模糊图像的有意义轨迹，替代传统扩散模型中的加性噪声过程，并通过频域分解实现闭合形式的中间状态。
AI.result: 该方法桥接了模糊的数学原理与扩散模型迭代设计之间的鸿沟，实现了更物理合理的图像去模糊模型，且原理可推广到其他类型的模糊。
AI.conclusion: ConvDiff通过将扩散模型中的加法操作替换为卷积操作，使去模糊任务更符合物理实际，为图像恢复提供了更有效的框架。

title: Meta-Agent: From Task Descriptions to Verified Multi-Agent Systems
summary: AI agents are increasingly used to solve complex, multi-step tasks, but existing multi-agent frameworks remain brittle as workflows grow in scale and depth. Small errors at intermediate stages can propagate through agent interactions, while insufficient grounding and weak verification mechanisms further limit reliability. We present Meta-Agent, a two-phase framework that automatically constructs and executes specialized multi-agent systems from natural-language task descriptions. In the construction phase, a task planner decomposes a problem into a directed acyclic graph of agent specifications with explicit input/output contracts and verification criteria. A web search module grounds each specification with external evidence, and a code generation module produces system prompts and tool configurations. A construction-time verification stage then validates generated artifacts and triggers targeted regeneration when failures are detected. In the execution phase, a coordinator dispatches subtasks across the agent graph while execution-time verification gates intermediate outputs. We further introduce a three-level error attribution mechanism that distinguishes local, upstream, and structural failures, enabling targeted recovery strategies ranging from localized retries to partial re-execution and re-decomposition. We evaluate Meta-Agent across coding, contextual learning, and open-ended reasoning tasks. Experiments against strong multi-agent baselines and ablation studies demonstrate consistent improvements in task success rate, error recovery, and workflow stability. The results highlight the importance of tightly integrating planning, grounding, and verification for building reliable multi-agent systems.

AI.tldr: Meta-Agent是一个两阶段框架，能够从自然语言任务描述中自动构建并执行专门的多智能体系统，通过任务分解、网络搜索验证、代码生成以及三级错误归因机制，显著提升多智能体工作流的可靠性和任务成功率。
AI.motivation: 现有的大规模多智能体框架在处理复杂多步任务时存在脆弱性，中间阶段的微小错误会通过智能体交互传播，同时缺乏充分的grounding和有效的验证机制，导致系统可靠性不足。
AI.method: 两阶段框架：1) 构建阶段——任务规划器将问题分解为有向无环图（DAG）形式的智能体规范（含输入/输出契约和验证标准），网络搜索模块提供外部证据，代码生成模块生成系统提示和工具配置，构建时验证触发定向重生成；2) 执行阶段——协调器调度子任务，执行时验证把关中间输出。引入三级错误归因机制（本地、上游、结构性失败）实现定向恢复策略。
AI.result: 在编码、上下文学习和开放式推理任务上，Meta-Agent相比强多智能体基线和消融实验，在任务成功率、错误恢复和工作流稳定性方面均取得一致性提升。
AI.conclusion: 紧密集成规划、grounding和验证对于构建可靠的多智能体系统至关重要。

title: Testing the Deliteralization Hypothesis in Human and Machine Translation
summary: The recent shift from dedicated NMT systems to general-purpose LLMs has reshaped machine translation, with LLMs reported to produce more fluent, less literal output than their predecessors. We test whether this shift extends to the deliteralization hypothesis, the long-standing claim from translation studies that translations become progressively less literal as they are drafted and revised. Using the WMT24++ dataset, we compare the literality of human translations and post-editions to that of two NMT systems and six LLMs across 54 language pairs and three tasks: direct translation, iterative self-revision, and post-editing of human drafts. Literality is measured via a validated Synthetic Literality Index built from six heuristics. We find that (i) human translations remain significantly less literal than those of all tested MT systems, though recent LLMs narrow the gap; (ii) when prompted to iteratively revise their own output, LLMs deliteralize monotonically, providing the first evidence that the hypothesis applies natively to LLM generation; and (iii) as post-editors, LLMs invert the revision triggers of human post-editors, tolerating literal drafts and targeting idiomatic human formulations for revision.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了从专用NMT系统到通用LLM的转变是否支持翻译研究的“去字面化假设”（即翻译在起草和修订过程中逐渐变得不那么字面化）。实验覆盖54个语言对，发现：人类翻译仍比所有机器翻译系统更不字面化，但LLM正在缩小差距；LLM在迭代自我修订中呈现单调去字面化；作为后编辑者，LLM与人类行为相反——容忍字面化草稿而修改地道的表达。
AI.motivation: 验证从NMT到LLM的范式转变是否改变了翻译的“去字面化”特性，即检验去字面化假设在新的翻译技术生态下是否仍然成立。
AI.method: 使用WMT24++数据集，比较人类翻译与后编辑、两种NMT系统、六种LLM在54个语言对上的字面化程度。包括三种任务：直接翻译、迭代自我修订、人类草稿后编辑。字面化程度通过由六种启发式方法构建的合成字面化指数进行量化。
AI.result: (1)人类翻译仍显著比所有机器翻译系统更不字面化，但LLM缩小了差距；(2)LLM在迭代自我修订中单调地去字面化；(3)作为后编辑者，LLM反转了人类后编辑的触发模式：容忍字面化草稿，反而修改地道的表达。
AI.conclusion: 去字面化假设在LLM生成中首次被验证成立，但LLM作为后编辑者的行为与人类相反，提示了未来人机协作翻译中需要关注的差异。

title: FrontierOR: Benchmarking LLMs' Capacity for Efficient Algorithm Design in Large-Scale Optimization
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used for optimization modeling and solver-code generation, yet practical operations research and optimization problems often require a harder capability: designing scalable algorithms that exploit problem structure and outperform direct formulation-and-solve baselines. Existing benchmarks are limited to small or simplified examples far below real-world scale and complexity. We introduce FrontierOR, among the first benchmarks to systematically evaluate LLM-based efficient algorithm design for realistic large-scale optimization problems. FrontierOR includes 180 tasks derived from methodologically diverse papers published in top-tier operations research venues, each with standardized instances and a hidden, expert-verified evaluation suite. We evaluate seven LLMs spanning frontier, cost-effective, and open-source models both in one-shot and test-time evolution settings. The results reveal that frontier models still struggle to move from executable formulations to efficient optimization algorithms: the strongest one-shot model outperforms Gurobi in only 31% of cases in both solution quality and computational efficiency, and even strong coding agents with test-time evolution achieve only 50% on selected hard tasks. FrontierOR establishes a practical evaluation platform for LLM-based optimization algorithm design, which enables future LLMs and agents to be systematically tested on whether they can move beyond correct formulation toward a feasible, high-quality, and efficient algorithm. Our FrontierOR Benchmark is available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/efficient-opt-bench-F03D.

AI.tldr: FrontierOR是首个系统评估大语言模型在现实大规模优化问题上设计高效算法的基准测试，包含180个来自顶级运筹学期刊的任务。结果表明，最强模型仅在31%的案例中同时优于Gurobi在解质量和计算效率上的表现，即使带测试时进化的编码智能体在难题上也仅达50%成功率。
AI.motivation: 现有基准测试局限于小规模或简化示例，远未达到现实世界的规模和复杂度，无法评估LLM设计可扩展、利用问题结构且超越直接建模求解基线的高效算法的能力。
AI.method: 从顶级运筹学期刊方法论多样的论文中构建180个任务，配备标准化实例和隐藏的专家验证评估套件；在一次性设置和测试时进化设置下评估7个涵盖前沿、高性价比和开源模型的大语言模型。
AI.result: 最强一次性模型仅在31%的案例中同时在解质量和计算效率上优于Gurobi；带测试时进化的强编码智能体在选定难题上仅达50%成功率；前沿模型仍难以从可执行公式转向高效优化算法。
AI.conclusion: FrontierOR为LLM驱动的优化算法设计建立了实用评估平台，有助于未来系统测试LLM和智能体能否超越正确公式化，实现可行、高质量且高效的算法。

title: From Facts to Insights: A Persona-Driven Dual Memory Framework and Dataset for Role-Playing Agents
summary: While role-playing agents excel in short-term interactions, long-term conversations overwhelm context windows, motivating external memory frameworks. Current systems typically rely on persona-agnostic summarization, which records facts without persona-specific interpretation, yielding generic responses that compromise persona fidelity. To bridge this gap, we introduce RoleMemo, a dataset featuring four reasoning tasks where the factual fragments must be interpreted through the persona to reach the correct answer. Evaluation on RoleMemo exposes critical limitations of persona-agnostic frameworks. We thus propose DualMem, which decouples memory into two streams: factual cognition and persona-conditioned insight. Trained through Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT) and Reinforcement Learning (RL), our framework with a 4B-parameter model outperforms zero-shot persona-agnostic frameworks powered by DeepSeek-V3.2 for sustained persona fidelity. Our resources are available at https://github.com/role2026/rolememo.

AI.tldr: 提出RoleMemo数据集和DualMem框架，通过将记忆解耦为事实认知和角色条件洞察，解决长程角色扮演对话中角色一致性保持问题，4B参数模型经SFT+RL训练后性能超越基于DeepSeek-V3.2的零样本方法。
AI.motivation: 现有角色扮演智能体在长程对话中依赖角色无关的摘要记忆，导致回答泛化、角色保真度降低，缺乏对角色的个性化解读能力。
AI.method: 构建RoleMemo数据集（包含四项推理任务）；提出DualMem框架，将记忆解耦为事实认知流和角色条件洞察流；采用监督微调（SFT）和强化学习（RL）联合训练。
AI.result: 4B参数模型在角色保真度上超越零样本角色无关框架（基于DeepSeek-V3.2）。
AI.conclusion: 通过记忆解耦和针对性训练，小参数模型也能在长程角色扮演中实现更好的角色一致性，验证了角色条件化记忆的有效性。

title: AstroRAG -- A Pagerank-Based Retrieval-Augmented Generation Pipeline for Question Answering in Astronomy
summary: Large language models (LLMs) demonstrate strong performance in natural language processing but often generate factual errors when relying solely on parametric knowledge. Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) mitigates these errors by grounding responses in external evidence, yet conventional retrieve-and-dump approaches frequently introduce irrelevant context that degrades answer quality. In this work, we present AstroRAG -- a PageRank-based retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) pipeline adapted for question answering in astronomy. The system performs token-aware chunking and per-instance, ephemeral indexing in Elasticsearch, then executes a two-stage retrieval: (i) Maximal Marginal Relevance (MMR) to obtain a small, diverse candidate set and (ii) a reader-driven PageRank (PR) re-ranking on a similarity graph to identify a compact, mutually supportive context under a strict token budget. Our design is training-free, privacy-preserving, and reproducible, as each instance is processed through transient indexing to prevent cross-task leakage. We evaluate the pipeline on the AstroQA benchmark for astronomy QA, and demonstrate competitive performance across all difficulty levels. In particular, the RAG-enhanced Mistral-7B achieves \textbf{79.49\% accuracy} and \textbf{79.49\% F1-score}, nearly doubling the performance of its non-RAG counterpart. These results highlight the effectiveness of disciplined retrieval and refinement in boosting domain-specific reasoning, establishing a robust foundation for extending RAG to other scientific fields.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 AstroRAG，一种基于 PageRank 的天文学问答 RAG 流水线，通过两阶段检索（MMR + PageRank 重排序）在 AstroQA 基准上使 Mistral-7B 准确率和 F1 达到 79.49%，近乎翻倍于无 RAG 版本。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型在依赖参数化知识时易产生事实性错误，传统 RAG 的 retrieve-and-dump 方式会引入无关上下文，降低回答质量。
AI.method: 1) Token-aware chunking + 临时索引 Elasticsearch；2) 两阶段检索：先 MMR 获取多样化候选集，再在相似图上用 reader-driven PageRank 重排序选出紧凑且互支持的上下文。
AI.result: 在 AstroQA 基准上，RAG 增强的 Mistral-7B 取得 79.49% 准确率和 79.49% F1 分数，性能几乎是未使用 RAG 版本的两倍。
AI.conclusion: 严格的检索与精炼策略能有效提升领域推理能力，为将 RAG 扩展到其他科学领域奠定了坚实基础。

title: PowLU: An Activation Function for Stable Pre-Training of LLMs
summary: In contemporary large language models (LLMs), the swish-gated linear unit (SwiGLU) activation function is widely adopted to regulate the information flow and introduce non-linearity. For large positive inputs, SwiGLU approximates the quadratic function $x^2$, providing strong nonlinearity and expressive capacity. However, this property also causes numerical instability as the input or model scale increases, particularly in low-precision LLM training. The main reason is its approximate quadratic amplification, which enlarges the output range and exacerbates outliers. To address this issue, we propose a stable activation function, Power Linear Unit (PowLU), for large-scale LLM pre-training. Specifically, PowLU employs a rational power function to achieve adaptive nonlinearity, thereby improving representation ability and enabling stable training in spike regions. Moreover, we provide theoretical justification for several key properties of PowLU. Scaling law experiments confirm that the performance is consistent across model sizes, and further experimental results with the Ling architecture (7.9B and 124B total parameters) demonstrate that PowLU achieves competitive results against SwiGLU and SwiGLU-Clip in large-scale training of LLMs. In addition, the experimental results also show that PowLU effectively improves the scalability of the large-scale training of LLMs.

AI.tldr: 针对SwiGLU在大规模低精度LLM训练中因近似二次函数导致数值不稳定的问题，本文提出PowLU激活函数，利用有理幂函数实现自适应非线性，在保持表达能力的同时提升训练稳定性，在7.9B和124B参数规模上取得与SwiGLU竞争的结果。
AI.motivation: SwiGLU激活函数对大幅正值输入近似于二次函数x²，虽然提供了强非线性和表达能力，但在模型规模或输入增大时会导致数值不稳定，尤其是在低精度训练场景下。其近似二次放大特性扩大了输出范围、加剧了异常值问题，亟需一种既能保持表达能力又能稳定训练的替代激活函数。
AI.method: 提出PowLU（Power Linear Unit）激活函数，采用有理幂函数实现自适应非线性，在尖峰区域既能保持强表达能力又能稳定训练。同时提供了PowLU关键性质的理论证明。
AI.result: 规模定律实验验证了PowLU在不同模型大小下的一致性；在Ling架构（7.9B和124B总参数）上的实验表明，PowLU在大规模LLM训练中取得了与SwiGLU和SwiGLU-Clip相当的结果，并有效提升了大规模训练的可扩展性。
AI.conclusion: PowLU作为SwiGLU的稳定替代方案，在保持竞争性能的同时解决了数值不稳定问题，提升了大规模LLM训练的可扩展性。

title: Whose Alignment? Comparing LLM Process Alignment Across Diverse Organizational Decision Contexts
comment: Accepted to ICML 2026 Pluralistic Alignment Workshop
summary: Aligning AI systems with organizational decision-making is typically framed as a single-target problem: make the model behave like the organization. We argue this framing obscures a deeper pluralistic challenge. We rely on a decision-policy capturing method to measure process alignment: whether an LLM weights information as the organization does, not merely whether it reaches the same conclusions. Applying this method to ECHR Article 6 decisions, process alignment strongly predicts output accuracy (r = 0.85, p < .001) and externalization substantially improves alignment for poorly-aligned models. Applying it to German consumer credit decisions, this relationship collapses (r = 0.15, p = .60): interventions produce inconsistent effects and the benchmark encodes potentially discriminatory historical patterns. This contrast is itself a pluralistic alignment finding: in contested domains, high process alignment is neither achievable via externalization nor unconditionally desirable. Output agreement alone cannot distinguish a model that has internalized an organizational policy from one that merely approximates its outcomes; process-level measurement is a necessary component of any pluralistic alignment evaluation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种"过程对齐"的衡量方法，用于评估LLM是否像组织一样权衡信息，而不仅仅是得出相同结论。通过对ECHR Article 6和德国消费信贷决策的对比分析，发现过程对齐与输出准确性关系在不同领域存在显著差异，揭示了单目标对齐框架的局限性，强调过程测量是多元对齐评估的必要组成部分。
AI.motivation: 传统上将AI系统与组织决策对齐视为单一目标问题（让模型行为像组织一样），但这种框架掩盖了更深层次的多元挑战。作者认为仅关注输出一致性不足以评估真正的对齐，需要从过程层面测量模型是否以组织的方式权衡信息。
AI.method: 使用决策策略捕获方法（decision-policy capturing method）来衡量过程对齐，即在两个领域（ECHR Article 6裁决和德国消费信贷决策）中评估LLM是否按照组织的权重结构处理信息，而非仅仅得出相同的最终结论。
AI.result: 在ECHR Article 6领域，过程对齐与输出准确性高度正相关（r=0.85, p<.001），且外部化（externalization）能显著改善对齐不良的模型。但在德国消费信贷领域，这一关系崩塌（r=0.15, p=.60），干预效果不一致，且基准编码了潜在歧视性的历史模式。
AI.conclusion: 输出一致性本身无法区分模型是真正内化了组织策略还是仅近似其结果。在有争议的领域中，高过程对齐既无法通过外部化实现，也并非无条件可取。过程层面的测量是任何多元对齐评估的必要组成部分。

title: Unbiased Diffusion Variational Inversion via Principled Posterior Matching
summary: Existing score-based methods for inverse problems often resort to approximate minimization of the KL divergence between the inversion distribution and the Bayesian posterior. Such an approximation leads to severe mode collapse and unreliable uncertainty quantification. In this paper, we propose Principled Posterior Matching (PPM), a framework that returns to the fundamentals of variational inference, rather than using tricky approximations. Instead of relying on heuristic approximations, we rigorously formulate the exact optimization of the KL divergence via the integration of Fisher divergence. We derive a tractable, equivalent gradient form of this integral, enabling precise optimization without the biases introduced by prior approximations. Our analysis clearly reveals that the mode collapse in previous methods stems directly from this approximation gap. Supported by our theoretical solution, PPM unifies two complementary paradigms: (1) In variational inference, PPM adopts mass-covering divergences that significantly improve the inversion diversity and uncertainty quantification; (2) In amortized inference, it enables the training of an efficient reconstruction network for rapid, single-step reconstruction. Furthermore, our formulation naturally extends to a broader family of divergence measures by generalizing the integral of the Fisher divergence. We validate PPM across challenging computational imaging tasks, including inpainting, super-resolution fluorescent microscopy, and radio interferometric black-hole imaging. In all experiments, PPM achieves superior reconstruction fidelity, faithful multimodal posterior recovery, and well-calibrated uncertainty estimates, establishing a robust framework for scientific imaging.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Principled Posterior Matching (PPM)框架，通过精确优化KL散度（而非近似）解决了基于分数的逆问题中模式坍塌和不确定性量化不可靠的问题，在多项计算成像任务中取得优异效果。
AI.motivation: 现有基于分数的逆问题方法通常近似最小化KL散度，导致严重的模式坍塌和不可靠的不确定性量化，亟需一种严格且精确的变分推断方法。
AI.method: PPM通过Fisher散度的积分精确优化KL散度，推导出等价的梯度形式，避免了近似偏差；并统一了变分推断（采用质量覆盖散度）和摊销推断两种范式。
AI.result: 在图像修复、超分辨荧光显微、射电干涉黑洞成像等任务中，PPM在重建保真度、多模态后验恢复和不确定性校准方面均优于现有方法。
AI.conclusion: PPM为科学成像建立了一个稳健的逆问题求解框架，有效解决了模式坍塌问题，并实现了可靠的不确定性估计。

title: Trait-Aware Policy Optimization for Autoregressive Multi-Trait Essay Scoring
summary: Multi-trait essay scoring aims to provide fine-grained evaluation of writing quality across multiple dimensions. However, how to effectively post-train autoregressive scoring models remains underexplored. In this paper, we propose Trait-Aware Policy Optimization (TAPO), a post-training framework tailored to autoregressive multi-trait scoring. Our method decomposes rewards along both the sample and trait dimensions, combining global scoring consistency, trait-level accuracy, format validity, and inter-trait dependency preservation. In addition, we enhance supervised fine-tuning with enhanced prompts, allowing the model to internalize trait semantics before preference optimization. Experiments across multiple backbone models show that our method consistently improves multi-trait scoring performance over supervised fine-tuning and scalar-reward optimization baselines, demonstrating the effectiveness and transferability of trait-aware post-training for essay scoring.

AI.tldr: 本文提出TAPO框架，通过多维奖励分解和策略优化，显著提升自回归模型在多维度作文评分上的表现。
AI.motivation: 现有自回归评分模型在多维度作文评分上的后训练方法尚未被充分探索，缺乏有效的细粒度优化策略。
AI.method: 提出Trait-Aware Policy Optimization (TAPO)框架，沿样本和特质维度分解奖励，结合全局评分一致性、特质级准确性、格式有效性和特质间依赖保持；并采用增强提示的监督微调来内化特质语义。
AI.result: 在多种骨干模型上的实验表明，TAPO相比监督微调和标量奖励优化基线，持续提升了多维度评分性能。
AI.conclusion: 特质感知的后训练框架能有效提升自回归模型在多维度作文评分上的表现，具有良好的迁移性和有效性。

title: AI Cartography: Mapping the Latent Landscape of AI Benchmark Ecosystems
summary: While aggregate leaderboard scores drive AI development, they contain substantial measurement noise whose sources and magnitudes remain unquantified, making it unclear when rankings reflect genuine capability differences versus evaluation artifacts. We introduce a framework for measuring the latent landscape in AI benchmark ecosystems. Applying Confirmatory Factor Analysis (CFA) and Generalizability Theory to 4,000+ models from the Open LLM Leaderboard, we decompose sources of ranking variance and establish: (1) structures assumed in current reporting practice underestimate the strength of relationships between benchmarks; (2) evidence of local dependence among leaderboard items, undermining uses of benchmarks as measurement instruments under current scoring systems; (3) contributor metadata explains more rank-relevant variance ($\approx9\%$) than architecture or deployment categories in this context; (4) a manifest-score "scaling law" slope has low reliability ($R_β=0.53$); by contrast, the latent general-factor size slope is highly stable across ecosystem controls ($R_g=0.97$). We are able to provide unique insights into benchmark dynamics, such as which benchmarks are a function of LLM size and which can be oppositely impacted by post-training practices. We provide actionable diagnostics to determine how benchmark rankings can be trusted and how benchmark design can be improved.

AI.tldr: 本文通过验证性因子分析和概化理论，对Open LLM Leaderboard上4000+模型进行测量噪声分析，发现当前基准评分体系存在显著结构性问题：基准间关系被低估、项目存在局部依赖、贡献者元数据比架构信息更能解释排名方差、显式评分"缩放律"斜率信度低而潜变量因子斜率高度稳定，并提供了改进基准设计的诊断方法。
AI.motivation: 聚合排行榜分数驱动AI发展，但其中包含大量未量化的测量噪声，导致难以区分排名反映的是真实能力差异还是评估伪影，因此需要建立量化框架来分解排名方差来源。
AI.method: 引入测量潜在景观的框架，对Open LLM Leaderboard上4000+模型应用验证性因子分析（CFA）和概化理论，分解排名方差来源并分析基准间关系、局部依赖、元数据贡献及缩放律信度。
AI.result: (1)当前报告低估基准间关系强度；(2)榜单项目存在局部依赖，损害评分体系作为测量工具的有效性；(3)贡献者元数据解释约9%排名方差，超过架构或部署类别；(4)显式"缩放律"斜率信度低（R_β=0.53），而潜变量因子斜率高度稳定（R_g=0.97），并揭示了不同基准受模型规模和后训练实践影响的不同模式。
AI.conclusion: 提供了可操作的诊断方法，用于判断基准排名的可信度以及改进基准设计，从而提升AI评估的科学性和可靠性。

title: Selective Latent Thinking: Adaptive Compression of LLM Reasoning Chains
summary: Explicit chain-of-thought (CoT) reasoning substantially improves the reasoning ability of large language models (LLMs), but incurs high inference cost due to lengthy autoregressive traces. Existing latent reasoning methods offer a promising alternative, yet they often treat reasoning as uniformly compressible, causing precision-critical intermediate steps to be overly compressed and thereby degrading reasoning accuracy. In this work, we propose Selective Latent Thinking (SLT), a framework that selectively compresses redundant reasoning spans into latent representations while preserving precision-critical spans as explicit CoT within the same reasoning trajectory. Specifically, SLT first uses a lightweight decoder to anticipate a short upcoming reasoning span, and then applies confidence-based gating to determine the longest span that can be reliably compressed. The accepted span is encoded into a compact latent representation to improve reasoning efficiency, while uncertain or precision-critical reasoning remains in explicit CoT form to preserve accuracy. To learn this selective compression policy, SLT adopts a three-stage training strategy that combines span-level latent compression, reliability-aware future reasoning prediction, and trajectory-level reinforcement learning to optimize the trade-off between answer correctness and reasoning cost. Extensive experiments across four mathematical reasoning benchmarks demonstrate that SLT achieves 22.7\% higher accuracy than latent reasoning baselines at comparable compression ratios, while reducing reasoning chain length by 58.4\% with only 2.8\% accuracy degradation compared to explicit CoT,Our code can be found in https://github.com/hunshi34/SLT.

AI.tldr: 提出Selective Latent Thinking (SLT)框架，通过选择性压缩冗余推理步骤为潜在表示，同时保留关键步骤为显式思维链，在提升推理效率的同时保持准确性。
AI.motivation: 现有显式思维链(CoT)推理虽能提升LLM推理能力，但生成冗长的自回归迹导致高推理成本；而现有潜在推理方法常将推理过程均匀压缩，导致精度关键步骤被过度压缩，降低推理准确性。
AI.method: SLT框架包含：1) 轻量级解码器预测短推理跨度；2) 基于置信度的门控机制确定可压缩的最长跨度；3) 三阶段训练策略（跨度级潜在压缩、可靠性感知的未来推理预测、轨迹级强化学习）优化准确性与推理成本的权衡。
AI.result: 在四个数学推理基准上，SLT在可比压缩比下比潜在推理基线准确率提升22.7%；相比显式CoT，推理链长度减少58.4%，准确率仅下降2.8%。
AI.conclusion: SLT通过选择性压缩策略有效平衡了推理效率与准确性，为LLM推理优化提供了新思路。

title: Context-CoT: Enhancing Context Learning via High-Quality Reasoning Synthesis
summary: While LLMs excel at reasoning over prompts using static pretrained knowledge, they struggle significantly with context learning-the ability to dynamically extract, internalize, and apply new knowledge from complex, task-specific contexts. Recent evaluations on the CL-Bench reveal a critical capability gap: frontier models solve only 17.2% of context-dependent tasks on average.

AI.tldr: LLMs在上下文学习（动态提取和应用新知识）方面表现不佳，前沿模型在CL-Bench测试中平均仅解决17.2%的任务。
AI.motivation: 当前LLMs在静态预训练知识推理上表现出色，但在需要动态学习新知识的上下文学习任务中存在显著能力差距，亟需系统评估和提升。
AI.method: 通过CL-Bench基准测试对多个前沿模型进行上下文学习能力的系统评估。
AI.result: 前沿模型在上下文依赖任务中的平均解决率仅为17.2%。
AI.conclusion: LLMs在上下文学习方面存在严重的能力缺陷，这是一个亟待解决的关键问题。

title: VEOcc: Voxel-Centric Online Semantic Occupancy Prediction For Embodied Scene Understanding
summary: Crucial for autonomous exploration, online 3D occupancy prediction and mapping incrementally constructs dense spatial representations on the fly. However, recent Gaussian-centric methods struggle with structural boundary fidelity and rely heavily on predefined scene-size priors, fundamentally limiting their operational efficiency. In this work, we present VEOcc, a voxel-centric framework formulated as a recursive perception-and-assimilation paradigm. By eliminating the need for initial scale estimation, VEOcc enables highly streamlined, open-ended map expansion. Furthermore, to robustly aggregate noisy temporal observations within the discrete voxel space, we propose a Spatio-Temporal-Aware Online Update Strategy. It integrates Cross-Temporal Logit Aggregation (TLA) for temporal consistency, Reliability-Aware Confidence Modulation (RCM) for spatial uncertainty calibration, and Confidence-Driven Incremental State Update (CSU) for robust global state assimilation. % Extensive experiments on Occ-ScanNet and EmbodiedOcc-ScanNet demonstrate that VEOcc establishes new state-of-the-art performance in both local and embodied settings, providing an accurate and efficient solution for real-world exploration. Extensive experiments on Occ-ScanNet and EmbodiedOcc-ScanNet demonstrate that VEOcc establishes new state-of-the-art performance in both local and embodied settings. Notably, zero-shot evaluations on self-collected video sequences further confirm its robust out-of-distribution generalization capability in completely unseen real-world environments. Ultimately, our framework provides an accurate and highly efficient solution for autonomous exploration. Code and supplementary visualizations are available on our project page: https://wryzju.github.io/VEOcc/.

AI.tldr: VEOcc提出了一种基于体素中心框架的在线3D占用预测与建图方法，通过递归感知-同化范式消除场景尺寸先验依赖，并引入时空感知在线更新策略，在局部和具身场景中均达到SOTA性能。
AI.motivation: 现有高斯中心方法在结构边界保真度上存在困难，且严重依赖预定义场景尺寸先验，限制了操作效率和开放环境下的部署能力。
AI.method: 提出VEOcc体素中心框架，采用递归感知-同化范式无需初始尺度估计；设计时空感知在线更新策略，包含跨时间逻辑聚合(TLA)、可靠性感知置信度调制(RCM)和置信度驱动的增量状态更新(CSU)。
AI.result: 在Occ-ScanNet和EmbodiedOcc-ScanNet数据集上达到新SOTA；在自采视频序列的零样本评估中展现出强大的分布外泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: VEOcc为自主探索任务提供了准确高效的在线3D占用预测与建图解决方案。

title: StreamProfileBench: A Benchmark for Fine-Grained User Profile Inference in Real-World Streaming Scenarios
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) have reshaped user profiling, yet current evaluations mainly focus on static data snapshots. This paradigm overlooks the reality of personalized systems, where User-Generated Content (UGC) arrives continuously and fine-grained profile evolve rapidly. To bridge this gap, we introduce StreamProfileBench, a large-scale benchmark for fine-grained streaming user profiling. We formalize streaming user profiling as a continuous state maintenance task and curate a highly authentic dataset comprising over 120,000 UGC posts from 7,000+ real users across five diverse platforms. By leveraging the temporal correlation of user interests, we further propose a novel, annotation-free evaluation framework. Extensive experiments across 14 leading LLMs reveal that continuous profile updating remains an open challenge. Models exhibit a systemic conservative bias, over-retaining past interests while failing to recognize interest decay. Ablation experiments further validate the practical utility and necessity of the streaming paradigm.

AI.tldr: 本文提出StreamProfileBench，一个面向细粒度流式用户画像的大规模基准，包含12万+真实用户生成内容，揭示了现有LLM在持续画像更新中存在的系统性保守偏差问题。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM用户画像评估仅基于静态数据快照，忽略了用户生成内容持续到达、画像快速演变的现实，亟需一个能够评估流式用户画像能力的基准。
AI.method: 将流式用户画像形式化为连续状态维护任务，构建包含7,000+真实用户、12万+条跨5个平台的多源数据集，并提出基于用户兴趣时间相关性的免标注评估框架。
AI.result: 对14个主流LLM的实验表明，持续画像更新仍是开放挑战：模型存在系统性保守偏差，过度保留过去兴趣，未能识别兴趣衰减。
AI.conclusion: 流式用户画像范式的实用性和必要性得到验证，现有LLM在动态兴趣追踪方面仍需显著改进。

title: Second Guess: Detecting Uncertainty Through Abstention and Answer Stability in Small Language Models
summary: Large language models often generate confident but incorrect answers rather than abstaining when uncertain. This problem is particularly acute for small language models (SLMs), where computational constraints and autonomous operation amplify the need for reliable uncertainty detection. We propose _Second Guess_, a lightweight, parameter-free prompting technique for abstention in multiple-choice question answering (MCQA) that is well-suited for SLMs. Our key empirical insight is that models which truly know an answer will select it consistently, while uncertain models exhibit unstable behavior when an ``I don't know'' option is added. Evaluated on four open models (2B-8B parameters) and four benchmarks, Second Guess achieves the highest composite risk improvement of 10.81\%. Notably, it maintains an 8\% composite risk improvement on fine-tuned models where entropy-based methods degrade, and improves most for lower-performing models. All code and results required to reproduce this work is available in https://github.com/Mystic-Slice/second-guess

AI.tldr: 提出了一种名为Second Guess的轻量级、无参数提示方法，通过在MCQA任务中为不确定的模型添加"我不知道"选项来提高小型语言模型的回答可靠性，在2B-8B参数的四个模型和四个基准上实现了10.81%的最高复合风险改善。
AI.motivation: 大型语言模型常自信地生成错误答案而非在不确定时放弃回答，这一问题在小型语言模型中尤为严重，因为计算约束和自主操作使得可靠的 uncertainty 检测更为关键。
AI.method: Second Guess是一种轻量级、无参数的提示技术，核心经验发现是：真正知道答案的模型会一致选择它，而不确定的模型在添加"我不知道"选项时会表现出不稳定行为。
AI.result: 在四个开放模型（2B-8B参数）和四个基准上实现了10.81%的最高复合风险改善；在微调模型上仍保持8%的复合风险改善（此时基于熵的方法性能下降），且对低性能模型提升最大。
AI.conclusion: Second Guess是一种有效且鲁棒的SLM不确定性检测方法，特别适合计算资源受限的场景，代码已开源。

title: WorldCraft: From Camera Navigation to Object Manipulation in Interactive Video World Models
summary: Recent video-based world models have made pixel-space environments interactive at the camera level: users can navigate viewpoints while the model generates coherent visual continuations. Yet their action spaces remain incomplete: users can move the camera, but cannot act on individual objects. Since real-world interaction is inherently object-centric, such models remain closer to passive scene observers than truly manipulable environments. We present WorldCraft, a framework that expands interactive video world models from camera navigation to object-level trajectory actions. Given a user click and a sketched path, WorldCraft generates future frames in which the selected object follows the prescribed trajectory while the camera continues to navigate the scene. WorldCraft achieves this through a trajectory-centric control pipeline: First, Normalized World Trajectory (NWT) represents user-drawn motion in a camera-invariant world coordinate system and dynamically re-projects it under the current camera pose, separating object motion from camera-induced screen-space displacement; Spatial-Pathway LoRA (SP-LoRA) then injects this world-space signal through the model's spatial-control pathway, adding object manipulation capability while preserving the pretrained camera controller; finally, Trajectory-Anchored State Persistence (TASP) treats the world trajectory as a persistent spatial state and refreshes autoregressive memory after trajectory-conditioned generation, allowing moved objects to reappear at their updated positions after leaving the camera view. Experiments show that WorldCraft enables accurate object control, preserves the video-based world model's camera fidelity under camera-only evaluation, and maintains object state across long autoregressive rollouts with off-camera excursions.

AI.tldr: WorldCraft将视频世界模型从仅支持摄像机导航扩展到支持物体级轨迹操作，通过归一化世界轨迹、空间路径LoRA和轨迹锚定状态持久化三项技术，实现了用户点击并绘制路径后，物体沿指定轨迹运动且摄像机可同时自由导航的效果。
AI.motivation: 现有视频世界模型只支持摄像机视角导航，无法对场景中的单个物体进行操作，缺乏物体级别的交互能力，限制了其作为可操作环境的实用性。
AI.method: 1) Normalized World Trajectory (NWT)：将用户绘制的运动轨迹编码到与摄像机无关的世界坐标系，并动态重投影到当前摄像机视角下；2) Spatial-Pathway LoRA (SP-LoRA)：通过模型的空域控制通路注入世界空间信号，增加物体操作能力同时保留预训练的摄像机控制器；3) Trajectory-Anchored State Persistence (TASP)：将世界轨迹作为持久化空间状态，在轨迹条件生成后刷新自回归记忆，使移出视野的物体能重新出现在更新后的位置。
AI.result: 实验表明WorldCraft实现了精确的物体控制，在仅用摄像机控制的评估下保持了原始视频世界模型的摄像机精度，并在长自回归生成及物体移出视野的情况下维持了物体的状态一致性。
AI.conclusion: WorldCraft成功将视频世界模型从被动场景观察者升级为可操作的物体级交互环境，填补了摄像机导航与物体操控之间的空白。

title: Uncertainty-DTW for Sequences and Visual Tokens
summary: Aligning structured data is a fundamental problem in computer vision and machine learning, underlying tasks such as time series analysis, human action recognition, and visual representation learning. Existing alignment methods, including Dynamic Time Warping (DTW) and its differentiable variants, rely on deterministic similarity measures and are therefore sensitive to heterogeneous and noisy features. In this work, we introduce uncertainty-aware alignment, a probabilistic framework that models pairwise correspondences with heteroscedastic uncertainty and performs structured matching along alignment paths. Our formulation, uncertainty-DTW (uDTW), assigns each correspondence a Normal distribution and parametrizes each alignment path by a Maximum Likelihood Estimate objective consisting of (i) a precision-weighted matching term that suppresses unreliable features, and (ii) a log-variance regularization that prevents degenerate solutions. This yields a probabilistic alignment mechanism that is robust to noise and interpretable, as uncertainty directly reflects the reliability of matches. We further generalize this framework from temporal sequences to tokenized visual representations, enabling structured matching over sets of visual tokens. The learned uncertainty can be interpreted as a reverse-attention: semantically relevant regions exhibit low uncertainty and dominate the alignment, while ambiguous/noisy regions have high uncertainty. This provides a connection between alignment, attention, and uncertainty modeling. We evaluate the proposed framework across diverse domains. The results demonstrate consistent improvements over state-of-the-art methods and show that learned uncertainty correlates with semantic importance. These findings establish uncertainty-aware alignment as a general, robust, and interpretable framework for learning from structured data.

AI.tldr: 本文提出不确定性感知对齐框架uDTW，通过异方差不确定性建模和极大似然估计实现结构化数据对齐，在时间序列和视觉表示任务上优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 现有对齐方法（如DTW及其可微变体）依赖确定性相似度度量，对异质性和噪声特征敏感，缺乏鲁棒性和可解释性。
AI.method: 提出uDTW框架：(1) 为每个对应关系赋予正态分布（异方差不确定性）；(2) 通过极大似然估计优化对齐路径，包含精度加权匹配项和对数方差正则化项；(3) 从时间序列泛化到视觉token表示，实现结构化匹配。
AI.result: 在多个领域任务上持续优于现有最先进方法，学习到的不确定性与语义重要性相关（低不确定性对应语义相关区域，高不确定性对应模糊/噪声区域）。
AI.conclusion: 不确定性感知对齐是一个通用、鲁棒且可解释的结构化数据学习框架，建立了对齐、注意力与不确定性建模之间的联系。

title: Adaptive Graph Refinement and Label Propagation with LLMs for Cost-Effective Entity Resolution
summary: Dirty entity resolution (ER), which identifies records referring to the same real-world entity from a single, messy dataset, is a fundamental task in data management and mining. However, the dominant blocking-matching-clustering paradigm for ER suffers from critical flaws. Its cascaded, decoupled workflow essentially produces a static, sparse graph plagued by missing edges (due to blocking failures) and noisy links (due to matching errors), causing error propagation and yielding suboptimal clusters, particularly when rigid transitivity is imposed in the clustering. We contend that matching and clustering are fundamentally synergistic, both optimizing for the construction of an ideal entity graph. Building upon this insight, we propose Alper, a unified framework that integrates these steps into an iterative probabilistic label propagation process over a global, evolving graph. Unlike disjoint blocking, Alper refines the graph structure and labels dynamically by adaptively integrating "weak but cheap" signals from graph propagation with "strong but expensive" LLM-based pairwise queries. For higher cost-effectiveness, we formulate the signal selection as a constrained optimization problem maximizing cumulative marginal gain under a query budget, solved via our greedy algorithm with provable theoretical guarantees. Our extensive experiments over eight benchmark datasets demonstrate that Alper is consistently superior to state-of-the-art cascaded pipelines.

AI.tldr: 提出Alper框架，将实体解析中的匹配与聚类步骤统一为迭代式概率标签传播过程，并自适应整合图传播的弱信号与LLM强查询，在预算约束下优化查询选择，显著优于传统级联流水线。
AI.motivation: 传统脏数据实体解析的阻塞-匹配-聚类级联范式存在错误传播、稀疏图、刚性传递性等根本性缺陷，匹配与聚类本应协同优化实体图的构建。
AI.method: 提出Alper统一框架：将匹配和聚类整合为迭代概率标签传播过程，动态融合图传播的弱信号与LLM强查询；将信号选择建模为在查询预算下最大化累计边际增益的约束优化问题，并用贪心算法求解。
AI.result: 在8个基准数据集上的实验表明，Alper一致性地优于最先进的级联流水线方法。
AI.conclusion: 匹配与聚类的协同优化能有效克服级联范式的错误传播问题，在有限LLM查询预算下实现更优的实体解析效果。

title: CODESKILL: Learning Self-Evolving Skills for Coding Agents
summary: Coding agents produce rich trajectories while solving software-engineering tasks. To enable agent self-evolution, these trajectories can be distilled into reusable procedural skills that compactly encode experience to guide future behavior. However, existing skill construction and maintenance methods often rely on fixed prompts and heuristic update rules, leaving it unclear how knowledge should be selected, abstracted, and maintained to best serve downstream agents. We propose CODESKILL, an LLM-based framework that reformulates skill extraction and skill-bank maintenance as a learnable management policy. CODESKILL extracts multi-granularity procedural skills from coding-agent trajectories, evolves skills with new experience, and maintains a compact skill bank for future task solving. We train CODESKILL with reinforcement learning, using a hybrid reward that combines dense rubric-based skill-quality feedback with sparse verifiable execution feedback from the frozen downstream agent. Experiments on EnvBench, SWE-Bench Verified, and Terminal-Bench 2 show that CODESKILL improves average pass rate by 9.69 over the no-skill baseline and by 4.01 over the strongest prompt-based or memory baseline, while maintaining the skill bank at a stable size during iterative construction.

AI.tldr: 提出CODESKILL框架，用强化学习训练技能提取与维护策略，使智能体从编程轨迹中自主学习可复用技能，在多个基准测试上提升9.69%通过率。
AI.motivation: 现有技能构建方法依赖固定提示和启发式更新规则，不清楚如何选择、抽象和维护知识以最好地服务下游智能体。
AI.method: 提出CODESKILL，基于LLM的框架，将技能提取和技能库维护重构为可学习的管理策略。从编码智能体轨迹中提取多粒度程序性技能，用新经验进化技能，维护紧凑技能库。使用强化学习训练，结合密集的基于评分标准的技能质量反馈和来自冻结下游智能体的稀疏可验证执行反馈的混合奖励。
AI.result: 在EnvBench、SWE-Bench Verified和Terminal-Bench 2上，CODESKILL相比无技能基线平均提升9.69%通过率，相比最强基于提示或记忆基线提升4.01%，同时技能库规模在迭代构建过程中保持稳定。
AI.conclusion: 将技能提取与维护作为可学习策略进行优化，能有效提升智能体性能并控制技能库规模。

title: Trust-Aware Joint Feature-Prediction Discrepancy for Robust Domain Adaptation
summary: Domain adaptation aims to mitigate performance degradation caused by distribution shifts between a labeled source domain and an unlabeled or sparsely labeled target domain. Most existing approaches estimate domain discrepancy either in feature space or in prediction space. However, these single-perspective strategies overlook a critical problem under domain shift: the reliability of the signals used for alignment. In practice, both learned representations and semantic predictions may become unreliable, and treating all target samples equally can lead to misleading alignment and suboptimal transfer. We introduce trust-aware domain adaptation, a principled framework that models domain discrepancy through the reliability of feature and prediction signals. Central to our approach is the Joint Feature-Prediction Discrepancy (JFPD), a unified formulation that jointly captures representation divergence and prediction divergence while weighting their contributions by sample-specific trust. Trust is quantified via two complementary mechanisms: uncertainty-aware trust, derived from prediction entropy to suppress unreliable predictions, and semantic-alignment trust, computed from prototype similarity in feature space to emphasize well-aligned representations. By prioritizing confident and semantically consistent samples while down-weighting noisy or ambiguous ones, JFPD provides a reliability-aware estimate of domain discrepancy. We further integrate JFPD into a training objective that guides adaptation toward trustworthy regions of the target domain. Experiments on standard benchmarks demonstrate that the proposed framework consistently achieves superior adaptation performance and yields discrepancy estimates that correlate with target-domain error. This work addresses, for the first time, the importance of modeling trust in the interaction between features and predictions for domain adaptation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种信任感知的域自适应框架，通过联合特征-预测差异（JFPD）并引入样本级信任机制（不确定性感知信任和语义对齐信任），解决了域偏移下特征和预测信号不可靠的问题，在基准测试上取得了优于现有方法的表现。
AI.motivation: 现有域自适应方法仅从特征空间或预测空间单一视角估计域差异，忽略了域偏移下特征表示和语义预测信号可能同时不可靠的问题，导致对齐误导和迁移效果次优。
AI.method: 提出联合特征-预测差异（JFPD）框架，通过不确定性感知信任（基于预测熵）和语义对齐信任（基于特征原型相似度）两种机制量化样本级信任，加权融合特征差异和预测差异，构建可靠性感知的域差异估计，并指导模型向目标域的可信区域进行自适应训练。
AI.result: 在标准基准数据集上，该方法在域自适应任务中持续取得优于现有方法的性能，且所估计的域差异与目标域错误率具有相关性。
AI.conclusion: 本文首次揭示了在域自适应中建模特征与预测之间交互信任的重要性，提出的信任感知框架为可靠域对齐提供了新思路。

title: Fine-Tuning Over Architectural Complexity: Broad-Coverage PII Detection on PIIBench with DeBERTa
summary: Personally identifiable information (PII) detection systems are frequently trained within narrow source or domain boundaries, limiting coverage when deployed on heterogeneous text. We study model fine-tuning on a corrected multi-source PIIBench preparation spanning 82 retained entity types across ten source datasets. We evaluate three DeBERTa-based approaches: direct token classification fine-tuning, a source-conditioned hierarchical model (SC+H), and a three-phase curriculum extension (SC+H+Curr). Against eight published comparator systems on a reproducible 5,000-record held-out subset (test_5k), direct fine-tuned DeBERTa achieves F1 0.6476, while SC+H and the curriculum variant achieve 0.5899 and 0.2772 respectively; the strongest published comparator reaches only 0.1723. Because validation initially favoured SC+H, we perform a final streamed evaluation on the complete 100,002-record held-out split. Direct fine-tuning remains superior, achieving F1 0.6455 versus 0.5894 for SC+H. Entity-level analysis shows that direct fine tuning wins 54 of 82 fine entity types and all ten coarse groups by support-weighted entity F1, while SC+H retains localised advantages on 28 types. The results indicate that diverse task-specific training data and a simple weighted cross-entropy objective contribute more to broad-coverage PII detection than the tested architectural and curriculum complexity.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了在多样化的多源PII数据集上微调DeBERTa模型，发现直接微调（F1 0.6455）优于层次化模型和课程学习策略，表明多样化的训练数据和简单的加权交叉熵目标比复杂的架构和课程设计更有效。
AI.motivation: 现有的PII检测系统通常在狭窄的源域或领域边界内训练，导致在异构文本上部署时覆盖范围有限，因此需要研究如何提升模型在多样化数据上的泛化能力。
AI.method: 研究者构建了包含10个源数据集、82种实体类型的多源PIIBench，并比较了三种DeBERTa方法：直接token分类微调、源条件层次化模型（SC+H）以及三阶段课程扩展（SC+H+Curr），在5,000条和100,002条测试集上进行评估。
AI.result: 直接微调的DeBERTa在测试集上取得F1 0.6455，优于SC+H（0.5894）和SC+H+Curr（0.2772），远超最强公开基线（0.1723）。直接微调在82种细粒度类型中获胜54种，在所有10个粗粒度组中全部获胜。
AI.conclusion: 多样化的任务特定训练数据和简单的加权交叉熵目标对广覆盖PII检测的贡献大于所测试的架构复杂性和课程学习策略。

title: Security of OpenClaw Agents: Fundamentals, Attacks, and Countermeasures
summary: The rapid evolution of large language model (LLM)-driven autonomous agents has given rise to OpenClaw, a new class of open-source agent frameworks that operate as continuously running, skill-augmented systems with persistent memory, multi-channel interaction, and high degrees of autonomy. Such capabilities enable OpenClaw agents to autonomously execute complex, multi-step tasks and interact seamlessly with external applications, but simultaneously introduce a substantially enlarged attack surface. In particular, the combination of high-privilege operations and persistent memory exposes OpenClaw agents to various emerging threats, including skill poisoning, cognitive manipulation, multi-agent cascading failures, and supply-chain vulnerabilities. In this survey, we present a comprehensive study of the security landscape of OpenClaw agents. We first examine the general architecture and key characteristics that distinguish OpenClaw agents from traditional AI agent systems. We categorize existing security and privacy threats into a layered framework and analyze how vulnerabilities arise during agent reasoning, action execution, and external interaction. Representative defense mechanisms are also reviewed to draw the current defense landscape. Finally, several unresolved issues related to the reliability and trustworthiness of OpenClaw ecosystems are discussed.

AI.tldr: 本文综述了由大语言模型驱动的开源自主代理（OpenClaw）的安全现状，分析了其因持续运行、高权限和持久记忆等特性所带来的攻击面扩大问题，并分类讨论了安全威胁及防御机制。
AI.motivation: OpenClaw代理具备高自主性、持久记忆和多通道交互能力，但其安全风险尚未被系统梳理，亟需一个全面的安全视角分析其脆弱性。
AI.method: 采用分层分类的方法，从代理推理、行动执行和外部交互三个维度分析安全与隐私威胁，并梳理现有防御机制。
AI.result: 识别出技能投毒、认知操纵、多代理级联故障和供应链漏洞等新兴威胁，并勾勒了当前防御技术的现状。
AI.conclusion: OpenClaw生态系统在可靠性和可信性方面仍存在若干未解决的问题，需要进一步研究加以应对。

title: Clarify, Abstain or Answer? Strategising in Conversation with Belief-Augmented Generation
summary: Large language models (LLMs) define a distribution over text, which can be viewed as a probabilistic representation of uncertainty: sampling K responses yields a belief state - responses a model deems plausible. Existing work exploits this representation for narrow tasks like either decoding or selective prediction, and often requires manual interventions, not controlling generation directly. We propose Belief-Augmented Generation (BAG): grounding LLMs in their own belief state via the prompt and letting them reason over these K samples to decide on a conversational strategy: answer, clarify, or abstain. In a multi-turn ambiguous QA setting, we find that LLMs by default rarely clarify or abstain, ignoring uncertainty about the input or facts. BAG improves QA accuracy across six models and yields strategy decisions more faithful to the belief state than prompt-only baselines. Disentangling when to clarify from when to abstain, however, remains challenging.

AI.tldr: 本文提出信念增强生成（BAG）方法，让LLM通过自身生成的多个样本（信念状态）来判断是直接回答、澄清还是拒绝回答，在模糊问答场景中显著提升了准确性，且策略决策比纯提示基线更忠实于信念状态。
AI.motivation: 现有工作仅将LLM的概率分布用于解码或选择性预测等狭窄任务，且常需人工干预，无法直接控制生成。本文希望让LLM自主利用其信念状态来决定对话策略（回答/澄清/拒绝）。
AI.method: BAG：通过提示将LLM自身的信念状态（K个采样响应）反馈给模型，让模型基于这些样本推理，自主选择回答、澄清或拒绝的对话策略。
AI.result: 在六种模型上，BAG均提升了多轮模糊问答的准确率；其策略决策比纯提示基线更忠实于信念状态；但在区分"何时澄清"与"何时拒绝"上仍存在挑战。
AI.conclusion: BAG有效利用LLM自身的信念状态来引导对话策略，优于传统方法，但澄清与拒绝的边界仍需进一步研究。

title: On the Limits of Model Merging for Multilinguality in Pre-Training
summary: Endowing models with consistent multilingual performance can be achieved by mixing pre-training data, or post-training approaches such as language-specific model merging. In this work, we test whether merging can be applied to monolingually pre-trained models. We conduct a controlled study on the efficacy of mixed, merged, and monolingual pre-training setups. We find that while monolingual pre-training results in strong in-language performance, merging any combination of monolingual models leads to performance collapse due to interference. Our analysis suggests representational similarity is a prerequisite for model merging. We therefore conclude that the flexibility of merging in fine-tuning does not extend trivially to language-specific pre-training.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了将单语预训练模型通过合并（merging）方式实现多语言能力的可行性，发现合并会导致性能崩溃，而表征相似性是模型合并的前提条件。
AI.motivation: 探索是否可以通过合并单语预训练模型来获得一致的多语言性能，验证合并方法在预训练阶段的适用性。
AI.method: 对比了混合预训练、合并模型和单语预训练三种设置，通过控制实验分析合并单语模型的效果及性能崩溃的原因。
AI.result: 单语预训练在对应语言上表现良好，但合并任何组合的单语模型都会因干扰导致性能崩溃；表征相似性是模型合并的必要条件。
AI.conclusion: 合并方法在微调阶段的灵活性无法直接迁移到语言特定的预训练阶段。

title: ATWL: A Formal Language for Representing, Comparing, and Reusing Visual Analytics Workflows
summary: Visual analytics (VA) workflows are inherently complex, involving data transformation, feature engineering, visual representation, and human interpretation. They are typically described in unstructured prose, hindering systematic comparison, reuse of proven strategies, and training of novices. We present Artifact-Transform Workflow Language (ATWL), a domain-agnostic, declarative language that formally represents VA workflows by capturing their structure and underlying analytical intent. ATWL is built upon a modular ontology of eight artifact types (entities, features, arrangements, visualisations, patterns, models, knowledge, specifications) and transforms characterised by standardised intents (e.g., define-unit, characterise, contextualise, abstract). To show that formalisation effort need not impede adoption, we extract workflows from research papers through supervised interaction with LLM agents, reducing the human role to review and refinement. Using this process, we constructed a library of seventeen ATWL workflows from published VA papers. Cross-workflow analysis reveals structural regularities -- a recurrent meta-structure, recurring motifs, reusable building blocks, diverse iterative strategies, and cross-domain equivalences -- that remain invisible in prose. We further evaluate practical utility through a controlled experiment in which the same LLM addressed two analytical problems with the library supplied either as original papers or as ATWL representations. Both forms enabled useful recommendations, but the formal representation systematically added explicit iteration structure, typed data flow, fragment-level adaptation provenance, and compactness supporting scaling beyond what prose libraries can fit in an LLM's context. ATWL enables a transition from narrative descriptions to formally represented, comparable, and reusable analytical knowledge.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种名为ATWL的领域无关声明式语言，通过模块化本体和标准化意图将可视化分析工作流形式化表示，并利用LLM辅助从论文中提取工作流，实验证明形式化表示比散文描述更具结构化优势。
AI.motivation: 可视化分析工作流通常以非结构化散文描述，导致难以系统比较、重用成熟策略和培训新手，需要一种形式化表示方法来解决这些问题。
AI.method: 设计了ATWL语言（基于8种工件类型和标准化转换意图），通过LLM智能体辅助从论文中提取工作流（人工仅需审查和细化），并构建了17个ATWL工作流库，最后通过控制实验评估其效用。
